natural_query: Give me kpi report
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_paid_invoices,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_won_deals,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' THEN s._id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS confirmed_sales_count,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i._id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS paid_invoices_count,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS won_deals_count
FROM 
  "sales" s 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.invoice_date = s.sales_date 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d."closeDate" = s.sales_date 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = s."salesOwner" 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = s.company 
WHERE 
  NOT s.deleted 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND NOT c.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND u."isActive" = TRUE 
  AND c."lifecycleStage" NOT IN ('Dead Customer', 'Inactive Customer')

natural_query: Compare last year revenue and current year and give me summary
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency, 'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_year_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_year_revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i

  i.payment_status = 'paid' AND 
  NOT i.deleted

natural_query: Give me open deals and that ratio of closed deals
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS open_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS closed_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS lost_deals,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0)::numeric / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100 AS win_ratio,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0)::numeric / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100 AS loss_ratio
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted

natural_query: Top performing sales owners in last 6 months with monthly trend
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS sales_owner,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) AS sales_month,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) AS sales_year,
  UPPER(COALESCE(s.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total),0) AS total_sales
FROM "sales" s
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = s."salesOwner"
WHERE 
  s.status = 'Confirm' 
  AND NOT s.deleted 
  AND u."isActive" = true
  AND NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 month'
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name, 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz),
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz),
  UPPER(COALESCE(s.currency,'USD'))
ORDER BY 
  sales_year, 
  sales_month, 
  total_sales DESC

  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Quotation Sent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS quoted,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Negotiation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_negotiation,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Contract Under Review' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS under_review,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_won
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY closed_won DESC NULLS LAST

natural_query: High activity companies with weak payment conversion

  COUNT(i._id) AS invoice_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_amount,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i._id ELSE NULL END) AS paid_invoices
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.invoice_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName"
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC, 
  paid_amount DESC

  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS avg_deal_size,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS win_rate_pct

natural_query: Compare revenue this month vs last month
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS this_month_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_month_revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) IN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1)
GROUP BY 
  1 
ORDER BY 
  1

  c."companyName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_amount,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_amount,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) / 
         NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0), 0), 2) AS payment_collection_rate
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName" 
ORDER BY 
  payment_collection_rate DESC 
LIMIT 50

natural_query: EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - d."closeDate") > 30*24*3600 AND d.stage = 'Analysis - To be Quoted'
sql:
SELECT 
  d.name, 
  d.stage, 
  d.grand_total, 
  d.currency, 
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz)) AS time_diff 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz)) > 30*24*3600 
  AND d.stage = 'Analysis - To be Quoted' 
  AND NOT d.deleted

natural_query: Target achievement percentage per sales rep this month
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='Confirm' THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS achieved_amount,
  t."targetInUSD" AS target_amount,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='Confirm' THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) / t."targetInUSD", 2) AS achievement_pct
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id 
  AND t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND t.month = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date, '')::timestamptz) = t.year 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date, '')::timestamptz) = t.month 
  AND NOT s.deleted 
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name, t."targetInUSD" 
ORDER BY 
  achievement_pct DESC

natural_query: Sales rep ranking by win rate this year with deal counts
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id ELSE NULL END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS total_deals,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id ELSE NULL END)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id),0),1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  win_rate_pct DESC

natural_query: Which industries have the highest deal win rate?
sql:
SELECT 
  c."industry" AS industry,
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won_deals,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "deals" d

natural_query: Invoice aging breakdown — overdue 30, 60, 90 plus days with amounts
sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN NULLIF(i.due_date,'')::timestamptz < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 day' THEN 'Overdue > 90 days'
    WHEN NULLIF(i.due_date,'')::timestamptz < NOW() - INTERVAL '60 day' THEN 'Overdue 60-90 days'
    WHEN NULLIF(i.due_date,'')::timestamptz < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 day' THEN 'Overdue 30-60 days'
    ELSE 'Current'
  END AS aging_category,
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS amount
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status NOT IN ('paid','cancelled') 
  AND NOT i.deleted
GROUP BY 
  1, 2
ORDER BY 
  2, 3 DESC

natural_query: Calculate days in current stage for each deal
sql:

  d.stage AS current_stage, 
  COALESCE(NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz, 
           CURRENT_DATE - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS days_in_current_stage

  d.stage, 
  NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz AS close_date, 
  NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz AS won_date,

natural_query: SUM(invoices.grandtotal_in_usd) by EXTRACT(MONTH FROM invoices.invoice_date)

       COALESCE(SUM(i."grand_total"),0) AS total_revenue,
       UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency
FROM "invoices" i 
WHERE NOT i.deleted 
GROUP BY 1, 3 
ORDER BY 1

natural_query: Top 10 companies by total open deal pipeline value
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS pipeline_value
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.company = c._id 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName", 
  d.currency 
ORDER BY 
  pipeline_value DESC 
LIMIT 10

natural_query: Which sales reps have the highest average deal size this year?
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(AVG(d.grand_total), 0) AS avg_deal_size
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL 
  AND d.stage NOT IN ('Closed Lost', 'Closed Won')
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY 
  avg_deal_size DESC 
LIMIT 10

natural_query: Lead source performance — which source generates most converted customers?
sql:
SELECT 
  s."sourceName", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer' THEN c._id END) AS converted_customers
FROM 
  "sources" s
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c.source = s._id AND NOT c.deleted
GROUP BY 
  s."sourceName"
ORDER BY 
  converted_customers DESC
LIMIT 1

natural_query: Deals lost this year broken down by stage and owner
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage, 
  u.name AS owner_name, 
  COUNT(*) AS lost_deals_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_lost_value
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner 
WHERE 
  d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."dealLostAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  d.stage, 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  lost_deals_count DESC, 
  total_lost_value DESC

natural_query: Overdue task aging — tasks past due by 7, 14, 30 plus days per user
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS assignee_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOW() - NULLIF(ct.due_date,'')::timestamptz BETWEEN INTERVAL '0 days' AND INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_7_days,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOW() - NULLIF(ct.due_date,'')::timestamptz BETWEEN INTERVAL '8 days' AND INTERVAL '14 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_14_days,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOW() - NULLIF(ct.due_date,'')::timestamptz BETWEEN INTERVAL '15 days' AND INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_30_days,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOW() - NULLIF(ct.due_date,'')::timestamptz > INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_30_plus_days
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "createtasks" ct ON ct."createdBy" = u._id AND ct.status != 'Completed' AND NOT ct.deleted
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY 
  overdue_7_days DESC, 
  overdue_14_days DESC, 
  overdue_30_days DESC, 
  overdue_30_plus_days DESC

natural_query: Active contacts per company with their lifecycle stage breakdown
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN co."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead' THEN co._id END) AS "lead_contacts", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN co."lifecycleStage" != 'Lead' THEN co._id END) AS "non_lead_contacts",
  COUNT(DISTINCT co._id) AS total_contacts

natural_query: Which deals changed stage in the last 7 days?
sql:

natural_query: Rank companies by sum of open deal pipeline value
sql:
SELECT

FROM "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.company = c._id

natural_query: Top 10 companies by rank
sql:

natural_query: Compare confirmed sales amount this year vs last year by sales owner
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_year_sales,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_year_sales
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY 
  current_year_sales DESC, last_year_sales DESC

natural_query: Average invoice payment time by company — days from invoice date to payment date
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(i.invoice_date,'')::timestamptz))), 0) AS avg_payment_days
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' AND 
  NOT i.deleted AND 
  i.payment_date <> '' AND 
  i.invoice_date <> ''
GROUP BY 
  c."companyName" 
ORDER BY 
  avg_payment_days DESC

natural_query: SELECT SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd) AS total_overdue, r.name AS region_name FROM invoices i JOIN companies c ON i.company = c._id JOIN regions r ON c.region = r._id WHERE i.payment_status = 'overdue' GROUP BY r.name
sql:

FROM "invoices" i

JOIN "regions" r ON c.region = r._id 
WHERE i.payment_status NOT IN ('paid', 'cancelled')

natural_query: Which deals are expected to close this month with their owner and value?

  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

natural_query: Which users have the highest task completion rate this month?
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS user_name, 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_tasks,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status != 'Completed' AND NOT t.deleted THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS total_tasks,
  ROUND(100.0 * 
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT t.deleted THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 0), 2) AS completion_rate
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "createtasks" t ON t."createdBy" = u._id 
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(t."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(t."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY 
  completion_rate DESC NULLS LAST

natural_query: Show invoice collection trend — total paid amount per month for last 6 months
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i."payment_date",'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS total_paid_amount
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i."payment_date",'')::timestamptz) IN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)-6, 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)-5, 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)-4, 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)-3, 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)-2, 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)-1, 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE))
GROUP BY 
  1, 2
ORDER BY 
  1, 2

natural_query: confirmed sales by owner this month
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS owner_name, 
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total), 0) AS total_sales
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
  LEFT JOIN targets t ON t."userId" = u._id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = t.year AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = t.month

natural_query: Show contacts grouped by job title with count and their lifecycle stage distribution
sql:
SELECT 
  c."jobTitle", 
  COUNT(*) AS contact_count, 
  c."lifecycleStage", 
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead') AS lead_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer') AS customer_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."lifecycleStage" = 'Inactive Customer') AS inactive_customer_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."lifecycleStage" = 'Dead Customer') AS dead_customer_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."lifecycleStage" = 'Partner') AS partner_count
FROM 
  "contacts" c

natural_query: Show pending invoices grouped by company with total amount and days since due date

FROM "companies" c 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.company = c._id 
WHERE d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL AND NOT d.deleted 
ORDER BY c."companyName" ASC

natural_query: Show deals closing in the next 30 days with owner and expected revenue
sql:
SELECT 
  d.name AS deal_name, 
  d.stage AS deal_stage, 
  u.name AS owner_name, 
  d.currency AS deal_currency, 
  COALESCE(d.grand_total, 0) AS expected_revenue,
  NULLIF(d."closeDate", '')::timestamptz AS close_date
FROM "deals" d 
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner 
WHERE 
  d.stage IN ('Negotiation', 'Quotation Sent', 'Contract Under Review') 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND NULLIF(d."closeDate", '')::timestamptz <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND NULLIF(d."closeDate", '')::timestamptz > CURRENT_DATE 
ORDER BY close_date ASC

natural_query: COUNT contacts created by each user this month
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS user_name, 
  COALESCE(COUNT(c._id), 0) AS contact_count
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "contacts" c ON c."contactOwner" = u._id 
  AND c."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead' 
  AND c."leadStatus" = 'New' 
  AND NOT c.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  contact_count DESC

natural_query: Get users who created these contacts
sql:
SELECT u._id, u.name, u.email 
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "contacts" c ON c."contactOwner" = u._id 
WHERE c."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead' AND c."leadStatus" = 'New' AND NOT c.deleted 
ORDER BY u._id

natural_query: SELECT company FROM invoices WHERE payment_status = 'paid'
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(COALESCE(i."companyName",'Unassigned')) AS company 
FROM "invoices" i 
WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid' 
AND NOT i.deleted 
ORDER BY company ASC

natural_query: SELECT company FROM sales WHERE status = 'confirmed'
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName" 
FROM 
  "sales" s 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = s.company 
WHERE 
  s.status = 'Confirm' 
  AND NOT s.deleted 
  AND c."companyName" IS NOT NULL

natural_query: Find deal owners of deals created in the last 60 days
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u.name AS owner_name 
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
AND NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days') 
ORDER BY u.name ASC

natural_query: Find all active users
sql: SELECT _id, name, email, department FROM "users" WHERE "isActive" = true

natural_query: Average number of tasks per deal by owner
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS owner_name, 
  COALESCE(AVG(t.task_count), 0) AS avg_tasks_per_deal
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      d.owner, 
      COUNT(ct._id) AS task_count
    FROM 
      "deals" d 
      LEFT JOIN "createtasks" ct ON ct."dealsId" = d._id 
    WHERE 
      NOT d.deleted AND 
      NOT ct.deleted 
    GROUP BY 
      d.owner
  ) t ON t.owner = u._id
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  avg_tasks_per_deal DESC

natural_query: SELECT _id FROM companies WHERE "lifecycleStage" = 'Customer' AND "leadWonAt" IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF("leadWonAt", '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF("leadWonAt", '')::timestamptz) BETWEEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)
sql:

natural_query: Which contacts have been assigned to a user but have no outreach activity recorded?
sql:
SELECT c._id, c."firstName", c."lastName", c.email
FROM "contacts" c
LEFT JOIN "outreaches" o ON c.email = o.email AND NOT o."isDeleted"
WHERE c."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead'
  AND c."leadStatus" = 'New'
  AND c."contactOwner" IS NOT NULL
  AND o._id IS NULL
  AND NOT c.deleted

natural_query: Deals in pipeline, deal stages, deal values by stage
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS total_deal_value
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NULL 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  d.stage, 
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD'))
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC, 
  total_deal_value DESC

natural_query: Tasks completed, tasks pending, task distribution by team
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Completed' THEN 1 END) AS tasks_completed,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Pending' THEN 1 END) AS tasks_pending,
  COUNT(*) AS total_tasks
FROM 
  "createtasks"
WHERE 
  NOT deleted 
  AND "createdBy" IN (SELECT _id FROM "users" WHERE "isActive" = true)

natural_query: Targets set, targets achieved, target vs actual revenue
sql:
SELECT 
  t.year,
  t.month,
  COALESCE(t."targetInUSD", 0) AS target_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total), 0) AS actual_revenue,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total), 0) / NULLIF(t."targetInUSD", 0), 2) AS achievement_pct
FROM 
  "targets" t
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = t."userId"
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s."createdAt", '')::timestamptz) = t.year
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s."createdAt", '')::timestamptz) = t.month
WHERE 
  t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  t.year, t.month, t."targetInUSD"
ORDER BY 
  t.year, t.month

natural_query: Sales performance by team, top performing sales reps, team targets
sql:
SELECT 
  u."isActive",
  u.name AS rep_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total),0) AS total_sales,
  t."teamName",
  t."targetInUSD"
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
  LEFT JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id AND t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
  AND s.status = 'Confirm' 
  AND NOT s.deleted 
  AND COALESCE(s.currency,'USD') = 'USD'
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name, 
  t."teamName", 
  t."targetInUSD", 
  u."isActive"
ORDER BY 
  total_sales DESC 
LIMIT 50

natural_query: Total revenue, revenue by region, top revenue generating products
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  1 
ORDER BY 
  2 DESC

natural_query: Sales performance by team, individual sales performance, team targets
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  u.department AS rep_department, 
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total), 0) AS total_sales,
  t."teamName" AS target_team,
  t."targetInUSD" AS team_target
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
  LEFT JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id AND t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name, 
  u.department,
  t."teamName",
  t."targetInUSD"
ORDER BY 
  total_sales DESC

natural_query: Deals in each stage, deal values, conversion rates
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_deal_value,
  ROUND(100.0 * 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 
    2) AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  d.stage
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: deals won, deals lost, win rate
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deals_won,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deals_lost,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)/NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0), 1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted

natural_query: rep names, total revenue, total deals created
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS total_deals_created
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: pending tasks per rep
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(COUNT(ct._id), 0) AS pending_task_count
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "createtasks" ct ON ct."createdBy" = u._id AND ct.status = 'Pending' AND NOT ct.deleted
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  pending_task_count DESC

natural_query: average deal size
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(d.grand_total), 0) AS average_deal_size 
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted

natural_query: rep details, individual revenue, deals created
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  u.email AS rep_email,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deal_count
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name, 
  u.email 
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Invoice count, payment amount, invoice date
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS invoice_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS payment_amount, 
  NULLIF(i.invoice_date, '')::timestamptz AS invoice_date
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.invoice_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  3 
ORDER BY 
  2 DESC

natural_query: Company name, total revenue
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id 
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName" 
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Contact count, task count, task status
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT c._id) AS contact_count, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT t._id) AS task_count, 
  t.status AS task_status
FROM 
  "contacts" c 
  LEFT JOIN "createtasks" t ON t."companyId" = c.company 
GROUP BY 
  3 
ORDER BY 
  task_status

natural_query: Deal count, deal value, deal stage
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_deal_value,
  d.stage
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  d.stage
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: Last activity date, activity type
sql:
SELECT 
  NULLIF(al."createdAt",'')::timestamptz AS activity_date,
  al.action AS activity_type 
FROM 
  "activitylogs" al 
ORDER BY 
  activity_date DESC

natural_query: Revenue breakdown by currency this year
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency, 'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  1 
ORDER BY 
  2 DESC

natural_query: Top companies by revenue this year
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(c."companyName",'Uncategorized')) AS company_name, 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS revenue 
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  1, 2 
ORDER BY 
  3 DESC 
LIMIT 10

natural_query: Total collected revenue this year
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue 
FROM "invoices" i 
WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

natural_query: Monthly revenue trend this year
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) AS month,
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency, 'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  1, 2
ORDER BY 
  1, 2

natural_query: Pending and overdue revenue amounts
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS pending_revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status IN ('pending', 'partial_payment') 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND NULLIF(i.due_date,'')::timestamptz < CURRENT_DATE 
GROUP BY 
  1 
ORDER BY 
  2 DESC

natural_query: Team revenue, team win rate, team members
sql:
SELECT 
  u."isAdmin", 
  u.name AS team_name, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT u._id) AS team_members,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won_deals,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_deals,
  ROUND(100.0 * 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) / 
    NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0), 
    2) AS win_rate_pct,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name, u."isAdmin" 
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Win rate percentage, deals won, deals lost
sql:
SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS win_rate_pct,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deals_won,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deals_lost
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted

natural_query: Pipeline value, forecasted revenue, deal stages
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS pipeline_value,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL 
  AND d.stage IN ('Analysis - To be Quoted', 'Negotiation', 'Quotation Sent', 'Contract Under Review', 'On Hold')
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  pipeline_value DESC

natural_query: YTD revenue, target revenue, revenue growth rate
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ytd_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(t."targetInUSD"), 0) AS target_revenue,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(SUM(t."targetInUSD"), 0) = 0 THEN NULL 
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(t."targetInUSD"), 0)) / COALESCE(SUM(t."targetInUSD"), 0), 2)
  END AS revenue_growth_rate
FROM "sales" s
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = s."salesOwner"
LEFT JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id 
                      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date, '')::timestamptz) = t.year 
                      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date, '')::timestamptz) = t.month
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND NOT s.deleted 
  AND u."isActive" = TRUE

natural_query: Achievement percentage, target achievement, team ranking
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='Confirm' THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END),0) AS achieved_amount,
  t."targetInUSD" AS target_amount,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='Confirm' THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END),0) / t."targetInUSD", 2) AS achievement_pct
FROM 
  "targets" t
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = t."userId"
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
                      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = t.year 
                      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = t.month
WHERE 
  t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND u."isActive" = true
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name, t."targetInUSD"
ORDER BY 
  achievement_pct DESC NULLS LAST

natural_query: Deals stuck in each stage for a specified period
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
  MIN(d."createdAt") AS oldest_deal_created_at,
  MAX(d."createdAt") AS latest_deal_created_at
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND (d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL)
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: Conversion rates between stages and overall funnel efficiency
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: Average deal progression time by stage and overall
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage, 
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))), 0) AS avg_progression_time
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted AND 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  avg_progression_time DESC

natural_query: Deals with high risk of loss or delayed close
sql:
SELECT 
  d.name, 
  d.stage, 
  d.grand_total, 
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency, 'USD')) AS currency, 
  d.type, 
  d."closeDate", 
  d."dealWonAt", 
  d."dealLostAt", 
  u.name AS owner_name
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND (d.stage IN ('On Hold', 'Negotiation') 
       OR d."closeDate" IS NULL 
       OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL 
       OR (d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d.stage NOT IN ('Closed Won', 'Closed Lost')))
ORDER BY 
  d."createdAt" DESC

natural_query: Deal count by stage and percentage of total deals
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage, 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count, 
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)::numeric/NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "deals" d2 WHERE NOT d2.deleted),0),2) AS percentage
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: Number of active deals, deal value per company
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS active_deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_deal_value,
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency, 'USD')) AS currency
FROM "deals" d
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company
WHERE 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND 
  d."dealLostAt" IS NULL AND 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c."companyName", 
  d.currency
ORDER BY 
  total_deal_value DESC

natural_query: Average payment delay, on-time payment rate per company
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(c."companyName",'Unassigned')) AS company_name,
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(i.due_date,'')::timestamptz))), 0) AS average_payment_delay,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz <= NULLIF(i.due_date,'')::timestamptz OR i.payment_status='paid' THEN 1 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2
  ) AS on_time_payment_rate
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND i.payment_status IN ('paid','partial_payment')
GROUP BY 
  c._id, c."companyName"
ORDER BY 
  on_time_payment_rate DESC, 
  average_payment_delay ASC

natural_query: Company name, total deals, total payments
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS total_deals, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_payments
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.company = c._id 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND (d.deleted IS NULL OR NOT d.deleted) 
  AND (i.deleted IS NULL OR NOT i.deleted) 
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName" 
ORDER BY 
  total_deals DESC, 
  total_payments DESC

natural_query: Task completion rate, overdue tasks per company
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN ct.status = 'Completed' THEN ct._id END), 0) AS completed_tasks,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN ct.status != 'Completed' AND NULLIF(ct.due_date, '')::timestamptz < NOW() THEN ct._id END), 0) AS overdue_tasks,
  ROUND(100.0 * 
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN ct.status = 'Completed' THEN ct._id END), 0) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(ct._id), 0), 2) AS completion_rate
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "createtasks" ct ON ct."companyId" = c._id AND NOT ct.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c._id, c."companyName"
ORDER BY 
  completion_rate DESC

natural_query: Deal count and value by stage, won/lost status
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lost_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS open_count,
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency, 'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_value
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  d.stage, 
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency, 'USD'))
ORDER BY 
  total_value DESC

natural_query: Deal count and value by deal type, time period, won/lost status
sql:
SELECT 
  d.type AS deal_type, 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_value,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS win_rate_pct,
  CASE 
    WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Won'
    WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Lost'
    ELSE 'Open'
  END AS deal_status
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.type, 
  CASE 
    WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Won'
    WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Lost'
    ELSE 'Open'
  END 
ORDER BY 
  total_value DESC

natural_query: Common reasons for won/lost deals by owner
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS owner_name, 
  d.type AS deal_type, 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count, 
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name, 
  d.type 
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: Deal count and value by owner, won/lost status
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS owner_name, 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won_deals,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lost_deals,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_value,
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency, 'USD')) AS currency
FROM "deals" d 
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name, d.currency 
ORDER BY total_value DESC

natural_query: Number of new leads per month for last 12 months
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS new_leads
FROM 
  "companies" c
WHERE 
  c."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead'
  AND NOT c.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz)
ORDER BY 
  month

natural_query: Monthly total revenue for last 12 months
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) AS month,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz) IN (
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 month')),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 month')),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '4 month')),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 month')),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 month')),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 month')),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '8 month')),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '9 month')),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 month')),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '11 month'))
  )
GROUP BY 
  1
ORDER BY 
  1

natural_query: Number of new deals per month for last 12 months
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS new_deals
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz)
ORDER BY 
  month

natural_query: Number of closed deals per month for last 12 months
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz) AS close_month,
  COUNT(*) AS closed_deals
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz) BETWEEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 11 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  1
ORDER BY 
  1

natural_query: Average deal cycle and wins by rep
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))), 0) AS avg_deal_cycle_days,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deal_wins
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY deal_wins DESC

natural_query: Average days in each deal stage
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))), 0) AS avg_days_in_stage
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  avg_days_in_stage DESC

natural_query: Top 5 deals with longest cycle by rep
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  d.name AS deal_name, 
  COALESCE(d."dealWonAt", d."dealLostAt")::timestamptz - d."createdAt"::timestamptz AS cycle_duration
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND (d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL) 
ORDER BY 
  cycle_duration DESC 
LIMIT 5

natural_query: Top 5 deals with shortest cycle by rep
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  d.name AS deal_name, 
  COALESCE(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - COALESCE(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz AS cycle_duration
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY 
  cycle_duration ASC 
LIMIT 5

natural_query: Companies with overdue invoices, total overdue amount
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_overdue_amount
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND i.payment_status NOT IN ('paid', 'cancelled') 
  AND NULLIF(i.due_date, '')::timestamptz < NOW() 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName" 
ORDER BY 
  total_overdue_amount DESC

natural_query: Total invoices, total amount, by status
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(i.payment_status) AS payment_status,
  COUNT(*) AS total_invoices,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_amount
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted
GROUP BY 
  1
ORDER BY 
  2 DESC

natural_query: Invoices by aging bucket (e.g., 0-30, 31-60, etc.)
sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN NULLIF(due_date,'')::timestamptz IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN NULLIF(due_date,'')::timestamptz < (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days') THEN 'Over 90 days'
    WHEN NULLIF(due_date,'')::timestamptz < (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days') THEN '61-90 days'
    WHEN NULLIF(due_date,'')::timestamptz < (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days') THEN '31-60 days'
    ELSE '0-30 days'
  END AS aging_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS invoice_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(grand_total), 0) AS total_amount
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND i.payment_status NOT IN ('paid', 'cancelled')
GROUP BY 
  1
ORDER BY 
  1

natural_query: Collection rates by company, by payment method
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  c."companyName",
  i.payment_status,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS total_amount,
  COALESCE(COUNT(i._id),0) AS invoice_count,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status='paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)/NULLIF(COUNT(i._id),0),2) AS collection_rate_pct
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  1, 2, 3 
ORDER BY 
  2, 1, 3

natural_query: Payment trends by company, by region, by payment method
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(i.currency, 'USD') AS currency,
  c."companyName",
  r."regionName",
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i._id) AS invoice_count
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
  LEFT JOIN "regions" r ON r._id = c.region
GROUP BY 
  1, 2, 3 
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Average, median, fastest, slowest sales cycle duration
sql:
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))),2) AS avg_sales_cycle_days,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))) AS median_sales_cycle_days,
  MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))) AS fastest_sales_cycle_days,
  MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))) AS slowest_sales_cycle_days
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND d.stage = 'Closed Won'

natural_query: Sales cycle duration for each sales representative
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NULLIF(s."createdAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz))), 0) AS avg_cycle_duration
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON u._id = s."salesOwner" AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  avg_cycle_duration DESC

natural_query: Distribution of sales cycle durations across all reps
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Analysis - To be Quoted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "Analysis - To be Quoted",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Quotation Sent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "Quotation Sent",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Negotiation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "Negotiation",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Contract Under Review' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "Contract Under Review",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'On Hold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "On Hold",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Closed Lost' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "Closed Lost",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.stage = 'Closed Won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "Closed Won"
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND d.stage IN (
    'Analysis - To be Quoted',
    'Quotation Sent',
    'Negotiation',
    'Contract Under Review',
    'On Hold',
    'Closed Lost',
    'Closed Won'
  ) 
  AND u."isActive" = TRUE 
ORDER BY 
  "Analysis - To be Quoted" DESC

natural_query: Sales cycle duration ranking for each sales representative
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))),0) AS avg_sales_cycle_days
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL AND NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY avg_sales_cycle_days DESC

natural_query: Time taken for each stage from lead creation to closed won
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))), 0) AS total_time_in_secs
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL AND 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  total_time_in_secs DESC

natural_query: AVG(sales.totalAmount) / COUNT(DISTINCT companies._id)
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(s.grand_total), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT c._id) 
FROM "companies" c 
LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s.company = c._id AND NOT s.deleted 
WHERE NOT c.deleted

natural_query: COUNT(companies._id) BY companies.lifecycleStage
sql:
SELECT 
  c."lifecycleStage", 
  COUNT(c._id) AS company_count
FROM 
  "companies" c
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c."lifecycleStage"
ORDER BY 
  company_count DESC

natural_query: COUNT(DISTINCT companies._id) WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM companies.createdAt) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c._id) AS company_count 
FROM "companies" c 
WHERE NOT c.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

natural_query: SELECT companies._id, companies.name FROM companies WHERE companies.lastActive < (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days')
sql:
SELECT c._id, c."companyName" 
FROM "companies" c 
WHERE c."createdAt" IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz < (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days')

natural_query: Sales owner's deal history, revenue history, conversion rate history
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS sales_owner,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz) AS won_year,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS deals_won,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(d._id), 1) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND u."isActive" = true
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name, 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz)
ORDER BY 
  won_year DESC

natural_query: Monthly deals, monthly revenue, monthly conversion rate
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)/NULLIF(COUNT(d._id),0),1) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  1 
ORDER BY 
  1

natural_query: Team average deals, team average revenue, team average conversion rate
sql:
SELECT 
  t."teamName", 
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id), 0) AS avg_deals, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(100.0 * 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id), 0), 1) AS avg_conversion_rate
FROM 
  "targets" t 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = t."userId" 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = t.year 
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = t.month 
    AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  t."teamName" 
ORDER BY 
  avg_deals DESC

natural_query: Sales owner ranking by deals, revenue, conversion rate
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS sales_owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id), 0), 
    2
  ) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND u."isActive" = TRUE
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC,
  conversion_rate_pct DESC

natural_query: Sales owner name, total deals, total revenue, conversion rate
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS sales_owner_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS total_deals,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id), 0), 
    1
  ) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  total_deals DESC

natural_query: Open deals by stage
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage, 
  COUNT(*) AS open_deal_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_value
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NULL 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  open_deal_count DESC

natural_query: Historical win rates by deal stage
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  COUNT(*) AS total_deals,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)/COUNT(*), 1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  d.stage
ORDER BY 
  win_rate_pct DESC

natural_query: Weighted deal values by stage
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage, 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_value,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) / NULLIF((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(grand_total), 0) FROM "deals" WHERE NOT deleted), 0), 2) AS weighted_percentage
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  weighted_percentage DESC

natural_query: Expected monthly closures
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz) AS close_month,
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won_deals
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d.stage IN ('Closed Won', 'Closed Lost') 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  1 
ORDER BY 
  close_month

natural_query: Number of tasks created this quarter
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS task_count 
FROM "createtasks" ct 
WHERE NOT ct.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM NULLIF(ct."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(ct."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

natural_query: Targets achieved, targets missed this quarter
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  t.year,
  t.month,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz) = t.year AND 
                          EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz) = t.month THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS achieved,
  t."targetInUSD" - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz) = t.year AND 
                                        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz) = t.month THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missed
FROM 
  "targets" t
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = t."userId"
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id
WHERE 
  t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND 
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CURRENT_DATE) = 
  CASE 
    WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) IN (1,2,3) THEN 1
    WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) IN (4,5,6) THEN 2
    WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) IN (7,8,9) THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name, t.year, t.month, t."targetInUSD"
ORDER BY 
  achieved DESC

natural_query: Deal, revenue, task trends this quarter
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ct._id) AS task_count
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "createtasks" ct ON ct."dealsId" = d._id
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  1, 2 
ORDER BY 
  1, 2

natural_query: Total deals, revenue this quarter
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_deals,
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency, 'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  2

natural_query: revenue growth rate by industry over time
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.invoice_date,'')::timestamptz) AS year,
  c.industry,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid'
GROUP BY 
  1, 2
ORDER BY 
  1, 2

natural_query: average deal size by industry
sql:
SELECT 
  c.industry, 
  COALESCE(AVG(d.grand_total), 0) AS avg_deal_size
FROM 
  "deals" d
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c.industry
ORDER BY 
  avg_deal_size DESC

natural_query: industry names and revenue totals
sql:
SELECT 
  c.industry, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS revenue_total
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id 
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  c.industry 
ORDER BY 
  revenue_total DESC

natural_query: deal count and win rate by industry
sql:
SELECT 
  c.industry, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deal_count,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id),0),1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  c.industry 
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: industry ranking by revenue and deal count
sql:
SELECT 
  c.industry, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deal_count
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c.industry
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC, 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: Monthly revenue for current year, last year, and two years ago
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) AS payment_year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) AS payment_month,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(i.currency) = 'USD' THEN i.grand_total ELSE i.grand_total * 1.0 END), 0) AS revenue_usd
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) IN (
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE),
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 2
  )
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz),
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz)
ORDER BY 
  payment_year, 
  payment_month

natural_query: Year-over-year growth rates for current year vs last year and two years ago
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) AS payment_year,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz)
ORDER BY 
  payment_year

natural_query: Monthly revenue trends for current year, last year, and two years ago
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) AS payment_year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) AS payment_month,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(i.currency) = 'USD' THEN i.grand_total ELSE i.grand_total * 1.0 END), 0) AS revenue_usd
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) IN (
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE),
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 2
  )
GROUP BY 
  1, 2
ORDER BY 
  1, 2

natural_query: Monthly revenue breakdown for current year, last year, and two years ago
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) AS year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) IN (

  )
GROUP BY
