ORDER BY 
  1, 2, 3

natural_query: SELECT _id, company_name FROM invoices WHERE due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND total_due > 0
sql:
SELECT i._id, i."companyName" 
FROM "invoices" i 
WHERE NULLIF(i.due_date,'')::timestamptz < CURRENT_DATE 
AND i.payment_status NOT IN ('paid','cancelled') 
AND i.grand_total > 0 
AND NOT i.deleted

natural_query: Total tasks, completed tasks, task status
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_tasks,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_tasks,
  status 
FROM 
  "createtasks" 
WHERE 
  NOT deleted 
GROUP BY 
  status 
ORDER BY 
  status

natural_query: User ID, task count, task status
sql:
SELECT 
  u._id AS user_id, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ct.status = 'Pending' THEN 1 END) AS pending_task_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ct.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 END) AS completed_task_count,
  COUNT(ct._id) AS total_task_count
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "createtasks" ct ON ct."createdBy" = u._id 
WHERE 
  NOT ct.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  u._id 
ORDER BY 
  total_task_count DESC

natural_query: User ID, task ID, task status, deadline
sql:
SELECT 
  u._id AS user_id, 
  ct._id AS task_id, 
  ct.status AS task_status, 
  NULLIF(ct.due_date,'')::timestamptz AS deadline
FROM 
  "createtasks" ct 
LEFT JOIN 
  "users" u ON u._id = ct."createdBy" 
WHERE 
  NOT ct.deleted 
ORDER BY 
  deadline ASC

natural_query: User ID, task count, deal count, completion rate
sql:
SELECT 
  u._id AS user_id,
  COALESCE(COUNT(ct._id), 0) AS task_count,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id), 0) AS deal_count,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    SUM(CASE WHEN ct.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(ct._id), 0), 
    2
  ) AS completion_rate
FROM 
  "users" u
  LEFT JOIN "createtasks" ct ON ct."createdBy" = u._id AND NOT ct.deleted
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  u._id
ORDER BY 
  task_count DESC, 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: User ID, deal ID, deal status
sql:
SELECT u._id AS user_id, d._id AS deal_id, 
       CASE 
           WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Won'
           WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Lost'
           ELSE 'Open'
       END AS deal_status
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
ORDER BY u._id, d._id

natural_query: Pipeline value (deals in progress) by region
sql:
SELECT 
  r."regionName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS pipeline_value,
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency, 'USD')) AS currency
FROM "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company
  LEFT JOIN "regions" r ON r._id = c.region
WHERE 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NULL 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  r."regionName", 
  d.currency
ORDER BY 
  pipeline_value DESC

natural_query: Top customers (by revenue) in each region
sql:
SELECT 
  r."regionName", 
  c."companyName", 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
  LEFT JOIN "regions" r ON r._id = c.region 
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND NOT c.deleted 
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid'
GROUP BY 
  r."regionName", 
  c."companyName", 
  i.currency 
ORDER BY 
  r."regionName", 
  total_revenue DESC 
LIMIT 100

natural_query: Win rate (deals won/lost) by region
sql:
SELECT 
  r."regionName", 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS deals_won, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS deals_lost,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM "deals" d 
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company
LEFT JOIN "regions" r ON r._id = c.region
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY r."regionName" 
ORDER BY win_rate_pct DESC

natural_query: Total revenue by region
sql:
SELECT 
  r."regionName", 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS amount
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
  LEFT JOIN "regions" r ON r._id = c.region 
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND NOT c.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  1, 2 
ORDER BY 
  3 DESC

natural_query: Number of deals, deal values by region
sql:
SELECT 
  r."regionName", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deal_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS total_deal_value,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS won_deals,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS lost_deals
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company 
  LEFT JOIN "regions" r ON r._id = c.region 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  r."regionName" 
ORDER BY 
  total_deal_value DESC

natural_query: Deal type, ranking by revenue, win rate, and deal size
sql:
SELECT 
  d.type AS deal_type, 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won_revenue,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS win_rate_pct,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS avg_deal_size
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.type 
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Product, deal type, total revenue generated
sql:
SELECT 
  p.name AS product_name, 
  d.type AS deal_type, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s._id = d._id 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i._id = s._id 
  LEFT JOIN jsonb_array_elements(s.items) AS item ON TRUE 
  LEFT JOIN "products" p ON p.name = item->>'name' 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  p.name, 
  d.type 
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Deal type, total revenue generated
sql:
SELECT 
  d.type AS deal_type, 
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  1, 2 
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Deal type, average deal size
sql:
SELECT 
  d.type AS deal_type, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) / COUNT(*) AS average_deal_size
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.type 
ORDER BY 
  average_deal_size DESC

natural_query: Deal type, win rate percentage
sql:
SELECT 
  d.type AS deal_type, 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 0) * 100 AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.type 
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: Active customer count
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c._id) AS active_customer_count 
FROM "companies" c 
WHERE c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer' AND NOT c.deleted AND c."companyOwner" IS NOT NULL

natural_query: Total revenue by customer
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency, 'USD')) AS currency, 
  c."companyName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid' 
GROUP BY 
  1, 2 
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Deal count for active customers
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deal_count 
FROM "deals" d 
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
AND c."lifecycleStage" != 'Dead Customer' 
AND NOT c.deleted 
AND c."leadStatus" != 'Lost Lead'

natural_query: Invoice history for active customers
sql:
SELECT 
  i.invoice_number, 
  i.invoice_date, 
  i.due_date, 
  i.payment_date, 
  i.payment_status, 
  i.grand_total, 
  i.currency, 
  c."companyName", 
  u.name AS "createdBy"
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = i."createdBy"
WHERE 
  i.payment_status NOT IN ('draft') 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND c."lifecycleStage" IN ('Customer', 'Inactive Customer') 
  AND c.deleted = FALSE 
  AND u."isActive" = TRUE 
ORDER BY 
  i.invoice_date DESC

natural_query: Lead count at each stage
sql:
SELECT 
  o.status AS stage,
  COUNT(*) AS lead_count
FROM 
  "outreaches" o
WHERE 
  NOT o."isDeleted"
GROUP BY 
  o.status
ORDER BY 
  lead_count DESC

natural_query: Lead drop-off rate at each stage
sql:
SELECT 
  o.status AS stage,
  COUNT(*) AS lead_count,
  LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY o.status) AS prev_stage_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * (1 - COUNT(*)::numeric / LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY o.status))::numeric, 2) AS drop_off_rate
FROM 
  "outreaches" o
WHERE 
  NOT o."isDeleted"
GROUP BY 
  o.status
ORDER BY 
  o.status

natural_query: Conversion rate from qualified lead to closed deal
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deals_won,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_deals,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)/NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner 
  LEFT JOIN "outreaches" o ON o.email = u.email 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND o.status = 'Converted to Deal' 
  AND o."leadStatus" IN ('Intrested', 'Verified')

natural_query: Time spent per stage
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage, 
  COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))), 0) AS time_spent
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  time_spent DESC

natural_query: Conversion rate from lead to qualified lead
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o."leadStatus" = 'Verified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS qualified_lead_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Not Contacted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_lead_count,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o."leadStatus" = 'Verified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) / 
    NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Not Contacted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0), 
    2
  ) AS conversion_rate
FROM 
  "outreaches" o 
WHERE 
  NOT o."isDeleted"

natural_query: Top 5 companies revenue amount
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(c."companyName",'Untitled')) AS company_name, 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS revenue_amount
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid'
GROUP BY 
  1, 2 
ORDER BY 
  3 DESC 
LIMIT 5

natural_query: Top 10, top 20 companies revenue amount
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(c."companyName",'Unnamed')) AS company_name, 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS revenue_amount
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid'
GROUP BY 
  1, 2 
ORDER BY 
  3 DESC 
  LIMIT 20

natural_query: Total revenue amount
sql:
SELECT UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency, COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS amount 
FROM "invoices" i 
WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid' AND NOT i.deleted 
GROUP BY 1 
ORDER BY 2 DESC

natural_query: Revenue from rest of companies
sql:
SELECT UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency, COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS amount 
FROM "invoices" i 
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
WHERE c."lifecycleStage" != 'Lead' AND NOT i.deleted 
GROUP BY 1 
ORDER BY 2 DESC

natural_query: total deal value, number of deals, risk percentage
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS total_deal_value,
  COUNT(*) AS num_deals,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 1 
ORDER BY 2 DESC

natural_query: owner, deal count, deal value, win/loss ratio
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS owner_name, 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_deal_value,
  ROUND(100.0 * 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY total_deal_value DESC

natural_query: deal deadline, deal value, owner
sql:
SELECT 
  d."closeDate" AS deal_deadline,
  COALESCE(d.grand_total, 0) AS deal_value,
  u.name AS owner_name
FROM "deals" d
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner
WHERE NOT d.deleted
ORDER BY d."createdAt" DESC

natural_query: deal stage, deal age, deal value
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage, 
  COALESCE(d.currency, 'USD') AS currency, 
  COALESCE(d.grand_total, 0) AS deal_value,
  COALESCE(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (CURRENT_DATE - NULLIF(d."createdAt", '')::timestamptz)), 0) AS deal_age_days
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
ORDER BY 
  deal_age_days DESC

natural_query: customer count, total revenue by revenue tier
sql:
SELECT 
  c."lifecycleStage" AS customer_stage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c._id) AS customer_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "companies" c
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id AND i.payment_status = 'paid' AND NOT i.deleted
WHERE 
  c."lifecycleStage" IN ('Customer', 'Dead Customer', 'Inactive Customer')
  AND NOT c.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c."lifecycleStage"
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: customer count, deal frequency by revenue tier
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  CASE 
    WHEN d.grand_total < 1000 THEN 'Low'
    WHEN d.grand_total < 10000 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'High'
  END AS revenue_tier
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.company = c._id 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName",
  revenue_tier 
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: total customers, total revenue, average deal value
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT c._id) AS total_customers,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT d._id), 0) AS average_deal_value
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.company = c._id 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND d.currency = 'USD'

natural_query: customer count, revenue by industry
sql:
SELECT 
  c.industry,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c._id) AS customer_count,
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS revenue
FROM "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid'
GROUP BY 
  c.industry, 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD'))
ORDER BY 
  customer_count DESC, 
  revenue DESC

natural_query: customer count, revenue by region
sql:
SELECT 
  r."regionName", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT c._id) AS customer_count, 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS revenue
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "regions" r ON r._id = c.region 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id AND i.payment_status = 'paid' AND NOT i.deleted
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted AND c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer'
GROUP BY 
  r."regionName", 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD'))
ORDER BY 
  customer_count DESC, 
  revenue DESC

natural_query: Number of new customers acquired by month
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS year,
  COUNT(c._id) AS new_customers
FROM 
  "companies" c
WHERE 
  c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer'
  AND NOT c.deleted
  AND c."leadStatus" IN ('Qualified', 'Pre-Qualified', 'Contacted', 'Attempted to Contact')
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz),
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz)
ORDER BY 
  year DESC, 
  month DESC

natural_query: Existing customer revenue by month and company
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  c."companyName",
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) AS payment_month,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer'
GROUP BY 
  1, 2, 3 
ORDER BY 
  2, 3

natural_query: New deal revenue by month and source
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  s."sourceName",
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS revenue
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company 
  LEFT JOIN "sources" s ON s._id = c.source 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  1, 
  2, 
  3 
ORDER BY 
  1, 
  2, 
  3

natural_query: Upsell revenue by month and company
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  c."companyName",
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS revenue
FROM "deals" d 
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company
WHERE 
  d.type = 'Upsell' 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  1, 2, 3 
ORDER BY 
  4 DESC

natural_query: Deal amount, deal type, won/lost status average
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  d.type AS deal_type,
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS total_value,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS win_rate_pct,
  CASE 
    WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Won'
    WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Lost'
    ELSE 'Open'
  END AS deal_status
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  1, 2, 6 
ORDER BY 
  total_value DESC

natural_query: Deal stage, won/lost status count
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS won_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS lost_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS open_count
FROM "deals" d
WHERE NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY d.stage
ORDER BY d.stage

natural_query: Deal type, won/lost status count
sql:
SELECT 
  d.type AS deal_type, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS won_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS lost_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS open_count
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY d.type 
ORDER BY won_count DESC, lost_count DESC, open_count DESC

natural_query: Total deals, won/lost ratio
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN "dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN "dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS lost_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN "dealWonAt" IS NULL AND "dealLostAt" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS open_deals,
  COUNT(*) AS total_deals,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN "dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS win_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN "dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS lose_rate_pct
FROM "deals" 
WHERE NOT deleted

natural_query: Owner, won/lost deal count, deal amount
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS owner_name, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS lost_deals,
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS total_deal_amount
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name, d.currency 
ORDER BY total_deal_amount DESC

natural_query: Monthly business summary
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i."payment_date",'')::timestamptz) AS payment_year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i."payment_date",'')::timestamptz) AS payment_month,
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.company) AS company_count
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid'
GROUP BY 
  1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 
  1, 2, 3

natural_query: Deals closed, targets achieved per month
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz) AS won_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deals_won,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  won_month
ORDER BY 
  won_month ASC

natural_query: New deals, tasks, outreaches created per month
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS new_deals
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted AND 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND 
  d."dealLostAt" IS NULL
GROUP BY 
  1, 2
ORDER BY 
  1, 2

natural_query: Invoices paid, payments received per month
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) AS payment_year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) AS payment_month,
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS total_paid
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted
GROUP BY 
  1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 
  payment_year, 
  payment_month, 
  currency

natural_query: Company name, last interaction date
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz AS last_interaction_date 
FROM 
  "companies" c 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted

natural_query: Company name, deal stage, pipeline value
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  d.stage, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS pipeline_value,
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency
FROM "deals" d 
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY c."companyName", d.stage, 4 
ORDER BY pipeline_value DESC

natural_query: Company name, health score, health score ranking
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  c."clientHealth", 
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c."clientHealth" DESC) AS health_score_ranking
FROM 
  "companies" c 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
ORDER BY 
  health_score_ranking ASC

natural_query: Sales rep name, total deals closed, deal win rate
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_deals_closed,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 
    2
  ) AS deal_win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  total_deals_closed DESC

natural_query: Sales rep name, target achievement percentage
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='Confirm' THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) / NULLIF(t."targetInUSD", 0), 2) AS target_achievement_pct
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id AND t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id AND 
                         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = t.year AND 
                         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = t.month
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name, t."targetInUSD" 
ORDER BY 
  target_achievement_pct DESC

natural_query: Sales rep name, overall ranking across metrics
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='Confirm' THEN s.grand_total ELSE 0 END),0) AS total_confirmed_sales,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status='paid' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END),0) AS total_paid_invoices,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id ELSE NULL END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id ELSE NULL END) AS lost_deals
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i."createdBy" = u._id 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
  AND (NOT s.deleted OR s.deleted IS NULL) 
  AND (NOT i.deleted OR i.deleted IS NULL) 
  AND (NOT d.deleted OR d.deleted IS NULL) 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY 
  total_confirmed_sales DESC NULLS LAST,
  total_paid_invoices DESC NULLS LAST,
  won_deals DESC NULLS LAST,
  lost_deals ASC NULLS LAST

natural_query: Sales rep name, total revenue generated
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
  AND s.status = 'Confirm' 
  AND NOT s.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Sales rep name, total tasks completed
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(COUNT(ct._id), 0) AS total_tasks_completed
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "createtasks" ct ON ct."createdBy" = u._id AND ct.status = 'Completed' AND NOT ct.deleted
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  total_tasks_completed DESC

natural_query: pipeline value, pipeline growth rate
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS pipeline_value
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  d.stage IN ('Negotiation', 'Quotation Sent', 'Analysis - To be Quoted', 'On Hold', 'Contract Under Review') 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  1 
ORDER BY 
  2 DESC

natural_query: user, target, achieved, variance
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  t."targetInUSD" AS target_amount,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS achieved_amount,
  (t."targetInUSD" - COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0)) AS variance
FROM 
  "targets" t
JOIN 
  "users" u ON t."userId" = u._id
LEFT JOIN 
  "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true
GROUP BY 
  u.name, t."targetInUSD"
ORDER BY 
  variance DESC

natural_query: user, achievement percentage
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS user_name, 
  COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s._id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / t."targetInUSD", 2), 0) AS achievement_pct
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id AND t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id AND 
                         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz) = t.year AND 
                         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz) = t.month
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name, t."targetInUSD" 
ORDER BY 
  achievement_pct DESC

natural_query: deal stage, average time spent, deal count
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NULLIF(d."dealWonAt",'')::timestamptz - NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))),0) AS avg_time_spent,
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY d.stage 
ORDER BY deal_count DESC

natural_query: deal stage, target, and actual sales
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS actual_sales,
  t."targetInUSD" AS target_sales
FROM 
  "deals" d
  LEFT JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = d.owner AND 
                            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = t.year AND 
                            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = t.month
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  d.stage, 
  t."targetInUSD"
ORDER BY 
  actual_sales DESC

natural_query: SELECT "currency" FROM invoices
sql: SELECT DISTINCT UPPER("currency") AS "currency" FROM "invoices" WHERE NOT deleted

natural_query: Company count, total value, this month vs last month change
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(al."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.company) AS company_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total), 0) AS total_value
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "activitylogs" al ON al."recordId" = d._id AND al.module = 'deals'
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND NULLIF(al."createdAt",'')::timestamptz >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days'
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(al."createdAt",'')::timestamptz),
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(al."createdAt",'')::timestamptz)
ORDER BY 
  month DESC

natural_query: Sales count, total value, year-to-date summary
sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS sales_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total), 0) AS total_sales_value,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz) AS sales_year
FROM "sales" s
WHERE NOT s.deleted AND 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz)
ORDER BY sales_year

natural_query: Count pending tasks for each sales rep
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(COUNT(ct._id), 0) AS pending_task_count
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "createtasks" ct ON ct."createdBy" = u._id AND ct.status = 'Pending' AND NOT ct.deleted
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  pending_task_count DESC

natural_query: Calculate win rate for each sales rep
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won_deals,
  COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS total_deals,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY win_rate_pct DESC

natural_query: List sales reps with revenue
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  UPPER(COALESCE(s.currency, 'USD')) AS currency
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name,
  s.currency
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: List sales reps with deals won
sql:
SELECT u.name AS rep_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deals_won 
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL AND NOT d.deleted 
WHERE u."isActive" = true 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY deals_won DESC

natural_query: COUNT(d.dealstage)

natural_query: COUNT(CASE WHEN d.dealstage='won' THEN 1 END)
sql:

natural_query: Total sales revenue by month
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz) AS month,
  UPPER(COALESCE(s.currency,'USD')) AS currency,

ORDER BY 1, 2

natural_query: Sales revenue by team
sql:
SELECT 
  t."teamName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total), 0) AS total_revenue,
  UPPER(COALESCE(s.currency, 'USD')) AS currency

LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = t."userId"

natural_query: Deals won vs deals lost
sql:

natural_query: share me tortal invoice?
sql:

natural_query: ELSN/2026/042 This invoice handeled by which user ?
sql:
SELECT u.name AS handled_by 
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i."createdBy" = u._id

natural_query: ELSN/2026/042 invoice details in 7 lines?

natural_query: give me invoices list
sql:
SELECT 
  i.invoice_number, 
  i.payment_status, 
  i.grand_total, 
  i.currency, 
  c."companyName", 
  i.invoice_date, 
  i.due_date, 
  i.payment_date

natural_query: Deals won, deals lost, conversion rate
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deals_won,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deals_lost,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)/
    NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) 
           + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted

natural_query: Target progress, target vs actual revenue
sql:
SELECT 
  t."teamName", 
  t.year, 
  t.month, 
  t."targetInUSD", 
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total), 0) AS actual_revenue
FROM 
  "targets" t 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = t."userId" 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz) = t.year 
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s."sales_date",'')::timestamptz) = t.month
WHERE 
  t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  t._id, t."teamName", t.year, t.month, t."targetInUSD"
ORDER BY 
  t.year, t.month

natural_query: New customers, customer growth rate
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) AS year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c._id) AS new_customers,
  LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT c._id)) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz)) AS prev_year_customers,
  ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(DISTINCT c._id) - LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT c._id)) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz))) / 
               NULLIF(LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT c._id)) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz)), 0), 0) AS customer_growth_rate_pct
FROM 
  "companies" c
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(c."createdAt",'')::timestamptz)
ORDER BY 
  year

natural_query: Total revenue, revenue by region
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(s.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total),0) AS total_revenue,
  r."regionName" AS region_name
FROM "sales" s 
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = s."salesOwner"
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = s.company
LEFT JOIN "regions" r ON r._id = c.region
WHERE NOT s.deleted AND u."isActive" = true
GROUP BY 1, 3 
ORDER BY 2 DESC

natural_query: how many lost deals from last 6 month

    AND d.type IN ('New Business', 'Upsell', 'Cross-sell') 
    AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL AND NOT d.deleted

  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."createdAt" >= '2026-04-20'

natural_query: Which deals have a close date this month?
sql:
SELECT d.name, d.stage, d."closeDate" 
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE d."closeDate" IS NOT NULL 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d."closeDate") = 5 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."closeDate") = 2026

  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL

natural_query: How many deals are in the negotiation stage?
sql:

FROM "deals"

natural_query: What is the total pipeline value of all open deals?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_pipeline_value 
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL AND NOT d.deleted

natural_query: List all deals with currency USD.
sql:
SELECT 
  d._id, 
  d.name, 
  d.stage, 
  d.grand_total_in_usd, 
  d.currency, 
  d.type 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  d.currency = 'USD' 
  AND NOT d.deleted

natural_query: How many deals of type "New Business" are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_business_deals FROM "deals" d WHERE d.type = 'New Business' AND NOT d.deleted

natural_query: What is the average deal value?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS average_deal_value FROM "deals" WHERE NOT deleted

natural_query: How many deals were created this month?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS deal_count 
FROM "deals" 
WHERE NOT deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "createdAt") = 5 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "createdAt") = 2026

natural_query: SELECT u.name, COUNT(d.dealId) as deal_count FROM deals d JOIN users u ON d.owner = u.userId GROUP BY u.name
sql:
SELECT u.name, COUNT(d._id) AS deal_count 
FROM "deals" d 
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY deal_count DESC

natural_query: SELECT u.name, SUM(d.dealValue) as total_pipeline_value FROM deals d JOIN users u ON d.owner = u.userId GROUP BY u.name
sql:
SELECT u.name, COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_pipeline_value 
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id AND NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name

natural_query: Which company has the highest number of active deals?
sql:
SELECT c."companyName", COUNT(*) AS active_deal_count 
FROM "companies" c 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.company = c._id AND NOT d.deleted AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL 
WHERE NOT c.deleted 
GROUP BY c._id, c."companyName" 
ORDER BY active_deal_count DESC 
LIMIT 1

natural_query: SELECT owner, COUNT(*) as total_closed FROM deals WHERE dealWonAt IS NOT NULL OR dealLostAt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY owner
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS owner, 
  COUNT(*) AS total_closed 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner 
WHERE 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
  OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  total_closed DESC

natural_query: SELECT owner, COUNT(*) as won_deals FROM deals WHERE dealWonAt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY owner
sql:
SELECT u.name AS owner, COUNT(*) AS won_deals
FROM "deals" d
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner
WHERE d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY u._id, u.name
ORDER BY won_deals DESC

natural_query: Show me deals won this quarter grouped by deal stage they were in before winning.
sql:
SELECT 
  de."closeDate" AS win_date,
  de."dealWonAt" AS win_time,
  dss."dealStageName" AS prev_stage
FROM 
  "deals" de
  JOIN "dealstagesettings" dss ON de.stage = dss."dealStageName"
WHERE 
  NOT de.deleted
  AND de."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM de."dealWonAt") = EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM de."dealWonAt") = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  de."closeDate",
  de."dealWonAt",
  dss."dealStageName"
ORDER BY 
  win_date DESC

natural_query: Which deals have been open for more than 90 days without closing?
sql:
SELECT d.name, d.stage, d."createdAt", 
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NOW() - d."createdAt")) AS days_open
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NOW() - d."createdAt")) > 90
ORDER BY days_open DESC

natural_query: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dealLostAt) AS month, COUNT(*) AS lost_count FROM deals WHERE dealLostAt >= '2026-01-01' AND dealLostAt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dealLostAt)
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d."dealLostAt") AS month,

  AND d."dealLostAt" >= '2026-01-01' 
  AND d."dealLostAt" < '2027-01-01' 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d."dealLostAt") 
ORDER BY 
  month

natural_query: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dealWonAt) AS month, COUNT(*) AS won_count FROM deals WHERE dealWonAt >= '2026-01-01' AND dealWonAt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dealWonAt)
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d."dealWonAt") AS month, 
  COUNT(*) AS won_count 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealWonAt" >= '2026-01-01' 
  AND d."dealWonAt" < '2027-01-01' 
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d."dealWonAt") 
ORDER BY 
  month

natural_query: SELECT company_id, SUM(deal_value) AS total_deal_value FROM deals WHERE dealWonAt >= '2026-01-01' AND dealWonAt < '2026-06-01' GROUP BY company_id
sql:
SELECT 
  d.company AS company_id, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_deal_value

WHERE 
  d."dealWonAt" >= '2026-01-01' 
  AND d."dealWonAt" < '2026-06-01' 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY

natural_query: SELECT name, total_won_deal_value FROM (SELECT users.name, SUM(deals.dealWonAt_value) AS total_won_deal_value FROM deals JOIN users ON deals.owner = users.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM deals.dealWonAt) = 2026 GROUP BY users.name) AS subquery ORDER BY total_won_deal_value DESC LIMIT 1
sql:
SELECT u.name, COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_won_deal_value
FROM "users" u
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id AND NOT d.deleted AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."dealWonAt") = 2026
GROUP BY u._id, u.name
ORDER BY total_won_deal_value DESC
LIMIT 1

natural_query: Show all deals with their company name, owner name, and current stage.
sql:
SELECT

  c."companyName" AS company_name, 
  u.name AS owner_name, 
  d.stage AS deal_stage
FROM 
  "deals" d 
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company AND NOT c.deleted 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner AND u."isActive" = true 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
ORDER BY 
  d."createdAt" DESC

natural_query: SELECT u.name, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND s.dealLostAt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS lost_deals FROM sales s JOIN users u ON s.sales_rep_id = u.id GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY lost_deals DESC
sql:
SELECT u.name, 
       COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS lost_deals 
FROM "sales" s 
JOIN "users" u ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
JOIN "deals" d ON d._id = s._id 
WHERE NOT s.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY lost_deals DESC

natural_query: SELECT u.name, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND s.dealWonAt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_rate FROM sales s JOIN users u ON s.sales_rep_id = u.id GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY win_rate DESC
sql:
SELECT u.name, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_rate 
FROM "sales" s 
JOIN "users" u ON u._id = s."salesOwner" 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d._id = s._id 
GROUP BY u.name 
ORDER BY win_rate DESC

natural_query: SELECT u.name, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND s.dealWonAt IS NOT NULL THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END) AS total_won_value FROM sales s JOIN users u ON s.sales_rep_id = u.id GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY total_won_value DESC
sql:
SELECT u.name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_won_value 
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY total_won_value DESC

natural_query: SELECT u.name, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('Open', 'Qualification', 'Demo') THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END) AS open_pipeline_value FROM sales s JOIN users u ON s.sales_rep_id = u.id GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY open_pipeline_value DESC
sql:
SELECT u.name, 
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('Open', 'Qualification', 'Demo') THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS open_pipeline_value 
FROM "sales" s 
JOIN "users" u ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
WHERE NOT s.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY open_pipeline_value DESC

natural_query: SELECT u.userId, u.name AS owner_name FROM users u JOIN deals d ON u.userId = d.owner WHERE d.createdAt < '2026-03-31' AND d.lastActivity < '2026-05-06'
sql:
SELECT u._id AS userId, u.name AS owner_name 
FROM "users" u 
JOIN "deals" d ON u._id = d.owner 
WHERE d."createdAt" < '2026-03-31' 
  AND d."createdAt" < '2026-05-06' 
  AND NOT d.deleted

natural_query: SELECT companyId, name FROM companies WHERE companyId IN (SELECT companyId FROM deals WHERE createdAt < '2026-03-31' AND lastActivity < '2026-05-06')
sql:
SELECT c._id AS companyId, c."companyName" AS name 
FROM "companies" c 
WHERE c._id IN (
  SELECT d.company 
  FROM "deals" d 
  WHERE d."createdAt" < '2026-03-31' 
  AND d._id IN (
    SELECT al."recordId" 
    FROM "activitylogs" al 
    WHERE al.module = 'deals' 
    AND al."createdAt" < '2026-05-06'
  )
) 
AND NOT c.deleted

natural_query: SELECT dealId, owner, companyId, createdAt, lastActivity FROM deals WHERE createdAt < '2026-03-31' AND lastActivity < '2026-05-06'
sql:
SELECT 
  d._id AS dealId, 
  d.owner, 
  d.company AS companyId, 
  d."createdAt" AS createdAt 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  d."createdAt" < '2026-03-31' 
  AND ( 
    SELECT MAX(al."createdAt") 
    FROM "activitylogs" al 
    WHERE al."recordId" = d._id AND al.module='deals' 
  ) < '2026-05-06' 
  AND NOT d.deleted

natural_query: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM created_at) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS deals_created FROM deals WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) IN (2026, 2025) GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM created_at), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at), quarter
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."createdAt") AS year,
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."createdAt") AS quarter,
  COUNT(*) AS deals_created
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."createdAt") IN (2025, 2026)
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."createdAt"),
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."createdAt")
ORDER BY 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."createdAt"),
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."createdAt")

natural_query: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM created_at) AS quarter, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) AS year, AVG(deal_size) AS avg_deal_size FROM deals WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) IN (2026, 2025) GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM created_at), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at), quarter
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."createdAt") AS quarter, 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."createdAt") AS year, 
  COALESCE(AVG(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS avg_deal_size 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."createdAt") IN (2025, 2026) 
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."createdAt"), 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."createdAt") 
ORDER BY 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."createdAt"), 
  quarter

natural_query: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM dealWonAt) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS deals_won FROM deals WHERE dealWonAt IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dealWonAt) IN (2026, 2025) GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM dealWonAt), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dealWonAt) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dealWonAt), quarter
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."dealWonAt") AS year,
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."dealWonAt") AS quarter,
  COUNT(*) AS deals_won
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."dealWonAt") IN (2025, 2026)
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."dealWonAt"),
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."dealWonAt")
ORDER BY 
  year, 
  quarter

natural_query: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM dealLostAt) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS deals_lost FROM deals WHERE dealLostAt IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dealLostAt) IN (2026, 2025) GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM dealLostAt), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dealLostAt) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dealLostAt), quarter
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."dealLostAt") AS quarter, 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."dealLostAt") AS year, 
  COUNT(*) AS deals_lost 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."dealLostAt") IN (2026, 2025) 
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."dealLostAt"), 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."dealLostAt") 
ORDER BY 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."dealLostAt"), 
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."dealLostAt")

natural_query: deal stage, count of deals
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage, 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: deal stage, average age of deals
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage AS deal_stage, 
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - d."createdAt"))), 0) AS avg_deal_age_days
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  d.stage
ORDER BY 
  avg_deal_age_days DESC

natural_query: deal stage, count of won and lost deals
sql:
SELECT 
  dss."dealStageName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won_deals,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lost_deals
FROM 
  "dealstagesettings" dss
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.stage = dss."dealStageName" AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  dss._id, 
  dss."dealStageName"
ORDER BY 
  won_deals DESC, 
  lost_deals DESC

natural_query: deal stage, sum of deal value
sql:
SELECT d.stage, COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_deal_value
FROM "deals" d
WHERE NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY d.stage
ORDER BY total_deal_value DESC

natural_query: deal stage, win/loss rate
sql:
SELECT 
  dss."dealStageName" AS stage_name, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id END) AS lost_deals,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS total_deals,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id END)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id),0),1) AS win_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id END)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id),0),1) AS loss_rate_pct
FROM 
  "dealstagesettings" dss 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.stage = dss."dealStageName" AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  dss._id, 
  dss."dealStageName"
ORDER BY 
  win_rate_pct DESC

natural_query: SELECT company_id, (won_deals * 1.0 / total_deals) AS conversion_rate FROM (SELECT company_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN dealWonAt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS won_deals, COUNT(*) AS total_deals FROM deals GROUP BY company_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) AS subquery
sql:
SELECT 
  c._id AS company_id, 
  (COALESCE(won_deals, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_deals, 0)) AS conversion_rate 
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      d.company AS company_id, 
      COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS won_deals, 
      COUNT(*) AS total_deals 
    FROM 
      "deals" d 
    WHERE 
      NOT d.deleted 
    GROUP BY 
      d.company 
    HAVING 
      COUNT(*) >= 3
  ) AS subquery 
  ON subquery.company_id = c._id 
ORDER BY 
  conversion_rate DESC

natural_query: SELECT company_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN dealWonAt IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS won_deals, COUNT(*) AS total_deals FROM deals GROUP BY company_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(d.company, '') AS company_id, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS won_deals, 
  COUNT(*) AS total_deals 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.company 
HAVING 
  COUNT(*) >= 3

natural_query: Which company has the highest total invoice value (paid)?

natural_query: What is the total outstanding (unpaid) amount by company?

natural_query: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM invoice_date) AS month, SUM(grandtotal_in_usd) AS total_unpaid FROM invoices WHERE payment_status!='paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)=2026 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM invoice_date)

natural_query: conversion percentages
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Converted to Deal' THEN o._id END), 0) AS converted_count,
  COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Contacted' OR o.status = 'Not Contacted' THEN o._id END), 0) AS contacted_count,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Converted to Deal' THEN o._id END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Contacted' OR o.status = 'Not Contacted' THEN o._id END), 0),
    2
  ) AS conversion_percentage
FROM 
  "outreaches" o
WHERE 
  NOT o."isDeleted"
  AND o."createdAt" >= '2025-05-21'
  AND o."createdAt" < '2026-05-21'

  LEFT JOIN "contacts" p ON p.email = o.email AND p."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead' AND p."leadStatus" = 'Converted to Deal' AND NOT p.deleted

natural_query: campaign_id, conversion rate, average conversion time
sql:
SELECT 
  c._id AS campaign_id,
  COALESCE(ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('Converted to Deal') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(o._id), 0), 2), 0) AS conversion_rate,
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o."createdAt" - c."createdAt"))), 0) AS avg_conversion_time
FROM "campaigns" c 
LEFT JOIN "outreaches" o ON o.campaign = c._id AND NOT o."isDeleted"
GROUP BY c._id 
ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC

natural_query: SELECT u.name, COALESCE(contacted_count, 0) as contacted_count, COALESCE(converted_count, 0) as converted_count, COALESCE(contacted_count, 0) * 1.0 / COALESCE(assigned_count, 1) as conversion_rate FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) as assigned_count, assigned_to FROM outreaches GROUP BY assigned_to) a ON u.id = a.assigned_to LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) as contacted_count, assigned_to FROM outreaches WHERE contacted_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assigned_to) c ON u.id = c.assigned_to LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) as converted_count, assigned_to FROM outreaches WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assigned_to) d ON u.id = d.assigned_to ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name, 
  COALESCE(c.contacted_count, 0) AS contacted_count, 
  COALESCE(d.converted_count, 0) AS converted_count, 
  COALESCE(c.contacted_count, 0) * 1.0 / COALESCE(a.assigned_count, 1) AS conversion_rate
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      COUNT(*) AS assigned_count, 
      "assignedTo" AS assigned_to 
    FROM 
      "outreaches" 
    WHERE 
      NOT "isDeleted" 
    GROUP BY 
      "assignedTo"
  ) a ON u._id = a.assigned_to 
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      COUNT(*) AS contacted_count, 
      "assignedTo" AS assigned_to 
    FROM 
      "outreaches" 
    WHERE 
      NOT "isDeleted" 
      AND status = 'Contacted' 
    GROUP BY 
      "assignedTo"
  ) c ON u._id = c.assigned_to 
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      COUNT(*) AS converted_count, 
      "assignedTo" AS assigned_to 
    FROM 
      "outreaches" 
    WHERE 
      NOT "isDeleted" 
      AND status = 'Converted to Deal' 
    GROUP BY 
      "assignedTo"
  ) d ON u._id = d.assigned_to 
ORDER BY 
  conversion_rate DESC

natural_query: SELECT t.userId, t.targetInUSD - COALESCE(s.achieved, 0) AS gap FROM targets t LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.salesOwner, SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd) AS achieved FROM sales s WHERE s.status = 'Confirm' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) = 4 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026 GROUP BY s.salesOwner) s ON t.userId = s.salesOwner WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.month) = 4 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.month) = 2026
sql:

    t."userId", 
    t."targetInUSD" - COALESCE(s.achieved, 0) AS gap
FROM 
    "targets" t
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        s."salesOwner", 
        SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd) AS achieved
    FROM 
        "sales" s
    WHERE 
        s.status = 'Confirm' AND 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) = 4 AND 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026

        s."salesOwner"
) s ON t."userId" = s."salesOwner"

natural_query: SELECT u.name, COUNT(*) AS months_hit FROM targets t JOIN users u ON t.userId = u.id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.month) IN (11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.year) = 2026 AND t.targetInUSD <= (SELECT SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd) FROM sales s WHERE s.salesOwner = u.id AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.createdAt) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.month) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.createdAt) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.year)) GROUP BY u.name
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name, 
  COUNT(*) AS months_hit
FROM 
  targets t
JOIN 
  users u ON t."userId" = u._id
WHERE 
  t.year = 2026 AND 
  t.month IN (11, 12, 1, 2, 3) AND 
  t."targetInUSD" <= (
    SELECT SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd)
    FROM sales s
    WHERE s."salesOwner" = u._id AND 
          EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) = t.month AND 
          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = t.year
  )
GROUP BY 
  u.name
ORDER BY 
  months_hit DESC

natural_query: who achieved target from last 6 months? give me names?
sql:
SELECT u.name
FROM "users" u
JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id
LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) = t.month
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM s.sales_date) = t.year
  AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
WHERE t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND t.month IN (11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4) 
  AND s.sales_date >= '2025-11-22'
GROUP BY u.name, t."targetInUSD"
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) >= t."targetInUSD"

natural_query: show deals by invoice
sql:
SELECT 
  d._id AS deal_id,
  d.name AS deal_name,
  d.stage AS deal_stage,
  d.grand_total_in_usd AS deal_grand_total,
  i._id AS invoice_id,
  i.invoice_number AS invoice_number,
  i.payment_status AS invoice_payment_status,
  i.grandtotal_in_usd AS invoice_grand_total
FROM 
  "deals" d
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = d.company AND NOT i.deleted
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d.type = 'New Business'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."createdAt") = 2026
ORDER BY 
  deal_grand_total DESC NULLS LAST

natural_query: Show all deals that have not had any activity in the last 30 days.
sql:
SELECT d.* 
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
  AND d._id NOT IN (
    SELECT al."recordId" 
    FROM "activitylogs" al 
    WHERE al.module = 'deals' 
      AND al."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  ) 
  OR d._id NOT IN (SELECT "recordId" FROM "activitylogs" WHERE module = 'deals') 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL

natural_query: Show all public leads with their status.

FROM "publicleads" pl 
LEFT JOIN "status" s ON s._id = pl."leadStatus"

natural_query: Which source generated inbound leads?
sql:
SELECT s."sourceName", COUNT(pl._id) AS lead_count
FROM "publicleads" pl
LEFT JOIN "sources" s ON s._id = pl.source
GROUP BY s._id, s."sourceName"
ORDER BY lead_count DESC

natural_query: List all deleted companies with deletion date.
sql:
SELECT "companyName", deleted, "createdAt" 
FROM "companies" 
WHERE deleted 
ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC

natural_query: what are the targets for year 2030
sql:
SELECT t."targetInUSD", t.month, t."teamName" 
FROM "targets" t 
WHERE t.year = 2030

natural_query: give me revenue of a month where no invoices were paid
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM "invoices" i
WHERE NOT i.deleted
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid'
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.payment_date) = 5

      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i2.payment_date) = 2026
  )

natural_query: how many deals were won today?
sql:

  AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM "dealWonAt") = EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND NOT deleted

natural_query: how many invoices are due tomorrow?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count

WHERE NOT i.deleted 
  AND i.due_date >= NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day'

natural_query: which reps have 0 open tasks?
sql:

natural_query: which companies have 0 deals?
sql:

  )

natural_query: which users logged in today?
sql:
SELECT u.name, u.email 
FROM "users" u 
JOIN "activitylogs" al ON al."userId" = u._id 
WHERE al."createdAt" >= '2026-05-22'
