natural_query: which sales rep won the most deals this month?
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deals_won
FROM 
  "users" u
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL AND NOT d.deleted
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d."dealWonAt") = 5 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."dealWonAt") = 2026 
  AND u."isActive" = true
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name
ORDER BY 
  deals_won DESC 
LIMIT 1

natural_query: which is the oldest deal in the pipeline?
sql:
SELECT d.name, d.stage, d."createdAt" 
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL AND NOT d.deleted 
ORDER BY d."createdAt" ASC 
LIMIT 1

natural_query: which user was created first in the system?
sql: SELECT name, email, "createdAt" FROM "users" ORDER BY "createdAt" ASC LIMIT 1

natural_query: How many invoices are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM "invoices" WHERE NOT deleted

natural_query: Show all outreach activities with their type and date.
sql:
SELECT oa._id, oa.name, oa.status, c."categoryName" AS type, oa."createdAt" 
FROM outreaches oa 
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c._id = oa.campaign 
WHERE NOT oa."isDeleted" 
ORDER BY oa."createdAt" DESC

natural_query: How many deals does each sales rep own, and what is their total pipeline value?
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COUNT(d._id) AS deal_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_pipeline_value
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL 
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  total_pipeline_value DESC

natural_query: What is the win rate (won vs total closed) by sales rep?
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS total_closed_deals,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / 
           NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 
    2
  ) AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "users" u
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name
ORDER BY 
  win_rate_pct DESC

natural_query: Compare won deals vs lost deals count by month for this year.
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d."dealWonAt") AS won_month,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS lost_deals
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."dealWonAt") = 2026
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d."dealWonAt")
ORDER BY 
  won_month

natural_query: What deal types (New Business, Upsell, Cross-sell) generate the most revenue?
sql:
SELECT 
  d.type AS deal_type, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d.type IN ('New Business', 'Upsell', 'Cross-sell')
GROUP BY 
  d.type
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Show all overdue invoices with company name, amount, and days overdue.
sql:
SELECT 
  i.invoice_number, 
  c."companyName", 
  i.grand_total AS amount, 
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NOW() - i.due_date)) AS days_overdue
FROM 
  "invoices" i
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company AND NOT c.deleted
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND i.due_date < NOW() 
  AND i.payment_status NOT IN ('paid', 'cancelled') 
ORDER BY 
  days_overdue DESC

natural_query: Compare paid vs unpaid invoice value by month this year.
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.payment_date) AS month,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i.grandtotal_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_value,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status != 'paid' THEN i.grandtotal_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpaid_value
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.payment_date)
ORDER BY 
  month

natural_query: Show companies with their invoice count and total revenue paid.
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COUNT(i._id) AS invoice_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue_usd
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id AND NOT i.deleted AND i.payment_status = 'paid'
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName"
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue_usd DESC

natural_query: Which companies have open deals AND unpaid invoices?
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c."companyName"
FROM "companies" c
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.company = c._id AND NOT d.deleted AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL
LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id AND NOT i.deleted AND i.payment_status != 'paid'
WHERE NOT c.deleted
  AND (d._id IS NOT NULL OR i._id IS NOT NULL)

natural_query: What is the monthly confirmed sales trend for this year?
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) AS sales_month,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_sales
FROM 
  "sales" s
WHERE 
  s.status = 'Confirm' 
  AND NOT s.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date)
ORDER BY 
  sales_month

natural_query: Compare confirmed vs non-confirmed orders by month.
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) AS month,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) AS year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status != 'Confirm' THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END) AS non_confirmed_orders
FROM 
  "sales" s
WHERE 
  NOT s.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date),
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date)
ORDER BY 
  year,
  month

natural_query: Which sales rep has the most confirmed orders this quarter?
sql:
SELECT u.name AS rep_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_sales
FROM "users" u
LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) IN (3,4,5) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026
  AND u."isActive" = true
GROUP BY u._id, u.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 1

natural_query: Show conversion funnel: total prospects → interested → converted with percentages.
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(p.total, 0) AS total_prospects,
  COALESCE(i.total, 0) AS total_interested,
  COALESCE(c.total, 0) AS total_converted,
  ROUND(COALESCE(i.total, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(p.total, 0), 2) AS interested_percentage,
  ROUND(COALESCE(c.total, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(p.total, 0), 2) AS converted_percentage
FROM 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM outreaches WHERE NOT "isDeleted" AND "leadStatus" = '-') p
  LEFT JOIN 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM outreaches WHERE NOT "isDeleted" AND "leadStatus" = 'Intrested') i 
  ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM outreaches WHERE NOT "isDeleted" AND "leadStatus" = 'Converted to Deal') c 
  ON TRUE

natural_query: What is the average unit cost by product type?
sql:
SELECT pt.name AS product_type, COALESCE(AVG(p.unit_cost), 0) AS average_unit_cost
FROM "products" p
LEFT JOIN "projecttypes" pt ON pt._id = p.product_type
WHERE p."isActive" = true
GROUP BY pt.name
ORDER BY average_unit_cost DESC

natural_query: Show products by currency — count and average unit cost per currency.
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(p.currency, 'USD') AS currency, 
  COUNT(p._id) AS product_count, 
  COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(p.unit_cost), 2), 0) AS average_unit_cost
FROM 
  "products" p
WHERE 
  p."isActive" = true
GROUP BY 
  p.currency
ORDER BY 
  product_count DESC

natural_query: Show notes breakdown by type (note, log, etc.) with count.
sql:
SELECT cn.type, COUNT(cn._id) AS note_count
FROM "commonnotes" cn
GROUP BY cn.type
ORDER BY note_count DESC

natural_query: How many tasks are linked to deals vs companies vs contacts?
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(d_task_count, 0) AS deal_task_count,
  COALESCE(c_task_count, 0) AS company_task_count,
  COALESCE(ct_task_count, 0) AS contact_task_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN "dealsId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d_task_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "companyId" IS NOT NULL AND "dealsId" IS NULL AND "invoiceId" IS NULL AND "salesId" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_task_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "contectId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ct_task_count
  FROM "createtasks"
  WHERE NOT deleted
) AS task_counts

natural_query: Who achieved their target last month? Show name, target, achieved, and gap.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  t."targetInUSD" AS target,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS achieved,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) - t."targetInUSD" AS gap
FROM "users" u
JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id
LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) = 4
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026
  AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
WHERE t.month = 4 AND t.year = 2026
GROUP BY u._id, u.name, t."targetInUSD"
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) >= t."targetInUSD"
ORDER BY gap DESC

natural_query: Who did not achieve their target last 3 months?
sql:
SELECT u.name 
FROM "users" u 
JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id 
LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = t.year 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) = t.month 
  AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted 
WHERE t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND t.month IN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 2, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)) 
GROUP BY u.name, t."targetInUSD" 
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) < t."targetInUSD"

natural_query: What is the team-wise target total for this quarter?
sql:
SELECT t."teamName", COALESCE(SUM(t."targetInUSD"), 0) AS total_target_usd
FROM "targets" t
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t."createdAt") = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t."createdAt") IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY t."teamName"

natural_query: Show target vs actual achieved comparison for all reps this year.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  t."targetInUSD", 
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS actual_achieved
FROM 
  "targets" t
  JOIN "users" u ON u._id = t."userId"
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
                     AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = t.year 
                     AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) = t.month 
                     AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
WHERE 
  t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name, t."targetInUSD", t.month
ORDER BY 
  rep_name, t.month

natural_query: Show each user with their deal count, invoice count, and total revenue.
sql:
SELECT u.name, 
       COALESCE(d.deal_count, 0) AS deal_count, 
       COALESCE(i.invoice_count, 0) AS invoice_count, 
       COALESCE(r.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue
FROM "users" u
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT d.owner, COUNT(d._id) AS deal_count
  FROM "deals" d
  WHERE NOT d.deleted
  GROUP BY d.owner
) d ON d.owner = u._id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT i."createdBy", COUNT(i._id) AS invoice_count
  FROM "invoices" i
  WHERE NOT i.deleted
  GROUP BY i."createdBy"
) i ON i."createdBy" = u._id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT i."createdBy", COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue
  FROM "invoices" i
  WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid' AND NOT i.deleted
  GROUP BY i."createdBy"
) r ON r."createdBy" = u._id
ORDER BY u.name

natural_query: Show users who have not logged in for 30+ days.
sql:
SELECT u._id, u.name, u.email 
FROM "users" u 
WHERE u."isActive" = true 
  AND u._id NOT IN (
    SELECT al."userId" 
    FROM "activitylogs" al 
    WHERE al."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  ) 
ORDER BY u.name

natural_query: Show email activity by user per week for last month.
sql:
SELECT u.name, EXTRACT(WEEK FROM ea.date) AS week_number, COUNT(*) AS email_count 
FROM "users" u 
JOIN "emails" ea ON u._id = ea.user 
WHERE ea.date >= '2026-04-22' AND ea.date < '2026-05-22' 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name, EXTRACT(WEEK FROM ea.date) 
ORDER BY u.name, week_number

natural_query: Which user performed the most actions this week?
sql:
SELECT u.name, COUNT(al._id) AS action_count
FROM "users" u
LEFT JOIN "activitylogs" al ON al."userId" = u._id
WHERE u."isActive" = true
  AND al."createdAt" >= '2026-05-15'
GROUP BY u._id, u.name
ORDER BY action_count DESC
LIMIT 1

natural_query: Show activity log timeline for the last 7 days grouped by user.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS user_name, 
  COUNT(al._id) AS activity_count
FROM 
  "activitylogs" al
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = al."userId"
WHERE 
  al."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name
ORDER BY 
  activity_count DESC

natural_query: Show notification volume by type per week.
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(WEEK FROM n."createdAt") AS week_number,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM n."createdAt") AS year,
  n.type,
  COUNT(*) AS notification_count
FROM 
  "notifications" n
WHERE 
  NOT n."isDeleted"
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(WEEK FROM n."createdAt"),
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM n."createdAt"),
  n.type
ORDER BY 
  year,
  week_number,
  notification_count DESC

natural_query: Show notes by contact method used (call, email, LinkedIn, etc.).
sql:
SELECT cn.type, COUNT(cn._id) AS note_count 
FROM "commonnotes" cn 
WHERE cn.type IN ('Call', 'Email', 'LinkedIn') 
GROUP BY cn.type 
ORDER BY note_count DESC

natural_query: Show each bill with vendor name, amount, status, and due date.
sql:
SELECT b._id, v."companyName" AS vendor_name, b."netPayableAmount", b.status, b."dueDate" 
FROM "bills" b 
LEFT JOIN "vendors" v ON v._id = b.vendor

natural_query: What is the total amount of overdue bills (past due date and unpaid)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b."netPayableAmount"), 0) AS total_overdue_amount 
FROM "bills" b 
WHERE b."dueDate" < NOW() AND b.status NOT IN ('Paid')

natural_query: Show each deal stage with count of current deals in that stage and total pipeline value.
sql:
SELECT 
  dss."dealStageName", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS current_deal_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_pipeline_value
FROM 
  "dealstagesettings" dss
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.stage = dss."dealStageName" AND NOT d.deleted AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL
GROUP BY 
  dss._id, 
  dss."dealStageName"
ORDER BY 
  dss."dealStageName"

natural_query: Compare conversion rates by lead source — companies that became customers vs total by source.
sql:
SELECT 
  s."sourceName", 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN c."lifecycleStage" IN ('Customer', 'Inactive Customer') THEN 1 END) AS converted_count,
  COUNT(c._id) AS total_count,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(CASE WHEN c."lifecycleStage" IN ('Customer', 'Inactive Customer') THEN 1 END)/COUNT(c._id),2) AS conversion_rate
FROM 
  "companies" c
  LEFT JOIN "sources" s ON s._id = c.source
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND c."lifecycleStage" IN ('Lead', 'Pre-Qualified', 'Qualified', 'Attempted to Contact', 'Contacted', 'Lost Lead', 'Customer', 'Inactive Customer', 'Dead Customer', 'Partner')
GROUP BY 
  s."sourceName"
ORDER BY 
  conversion_rate DESC NULLS LAST

natural_query: Show conversion rate by campaign — prospects added vs converted.
sql:
SELECT 
  c."campaignName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Converted to Deal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS converted_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_prospects,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Converted to Deal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate
FROM 
  "campaigns" c 
  LEFT JOIN "outreaches" o ON o.campaign = c._id 
  AND NOT o."isDeleted"
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."campaignName"
ORDER BY 
  conversion_rate DESC

natural_query: How many companies are in each region?
sql:
SELECT r."regionName", COUNT(c._id) AS company_count 
FROM "regions" r 
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c.region = r._id AND NOT c.deleted 
GROUP BY r._id, r."regionName" 
ORDER BY company_count DESC

natural_query: Which region generates the most revenue?
sql:
SELECT r."regionName", COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM "regions" r
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c.region = r._id
LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id AND i.payment_status = 'paid' AND NOT i.deleted
GROUP BY r._id, r."regionName"
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

natural_query: How many deals are in each project type?
sql:
SELECT 
  pt.name AS project_type_name, 
  COALESCE(COUNT(d._id), 0) AS deal_count
FROM 
  "projecttypes" pt 
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.type = pt.name AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  pt._id, pt.name 
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: Which project type has the highest average deal value?
sql:
SELECT pt.name, COALESCE(AVG(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS avg_deal_value
FROM "projecttypes" pt
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.type = pt.name AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY pt._id, pt.name
ORDER BY avg_deal_value DESC
LIMIT 1

natural_query: Show the lifecycle stage distribution for companies and contacts.
sql:
SELECT 
  'Company' AS entity_type,
  c."lifecycleStage" AS lifecycle_stage,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM 
  "companies" c
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c."lifecycleStage"
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Contact' AS entity_type,
  c."lifecycleStage" AS lifecycle_stage,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM 
  "contacts" c
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c."lifecycleStage"
ORDER BY 
  entity_type,
  lifecycle_stage

natural_query: Which lead status converts to customer most often?
sql:
SELECT ls.name, COUNT(c._id) AS conversion_count 
FROM "lead_statuses" ls 
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c."leadStatus" = ls.name 
WHERE c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer' 
GROUP BY ls.name 
ORDER BY conversion_count DESC 
LIMIT 1

natural_query: Show total revenue by payment mode.
sql:
SELECT 
  p.payment_name AS payment_mode, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "payments" p
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i._id::text = p."odoo_payment_id"::text
GROUP BY 
  p.payment_name
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Show meetings with their attendees and linked company or deal.
sql:
SELECT m.title, m.description, m.start, m.end, m.location, u.name AS attendee, c."companyName" AS company, d.name AS deal 
FROM "meetings" m 
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON m."createdBy" = u._id 
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON m."EventId" = c._id 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON m."EventId" = d._id 
WHERE NOT d.deleted OR d._id IS NULL 
ORDER BY m.start DESC

natural_query: Show public leads that were converted to contacts.
sql:
SELECT pl._id, pl."firstName", pl."lastName", pl.email, pl."phoneNumber", pl."leadStatus", pl."lifecycleStage"
FROM "publicleads" pl
WHERE pl."leadStatus" = 'Converted to Contact'

natural_query: How many open deals are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_deal_count FROM "deals" d WHERE d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL AND NOT d.deleted

natural_query: How many lost deals are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS lost_deal_count FROM "deals" WHERE "dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL AND NOT deleted

natural_query: give me last 6 months closed deals
sql:
SELECT 
  d.name, 
  d.stage, 
  d.grand_total_in_usd, 
  d."dealWonAt"
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND d."createdAt" >= '2025-11-23' 
ORDER BY 
  d."dealWonAt" DESC

natural_query: give me last 6 months won deals
sql:
SELECT d.name, d.stage, d.grand_total_in_usd, d."dealWonAt" 
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted AND d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL 
AND d."dealWonAt" >= '2025-11-23' 
ORDER BY d."dealWonAt" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50

natural_query: give me last 6 months lost deals
sql:
SELECT name, stage, "dealLostAt" 
FROM "deals" 
WHERE "dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND NOT deleted 
  AND "dealLostAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months' 
ORDER BY "dealLostAt" DESC

natural_query: how many deals are in each stage?
sql:
SELECT 
  d.stage, 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  d.stage
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: what is total revenue this year?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue FROM "invoices" i WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid' AND NOT i.deleted AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

natural_query: show me monthly revenue breakdown for this year
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.payment_date) AS month,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS revenue_usd
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.payment_date)
ORDER BY 
  month

natural_query: show revenue by company this year
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue_usd
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id AND NOT i.deleted
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName"
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue_usd DESC

natural_query: what is total value of unpaid invoices this year?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS total_unpaid_value FROM "invoices" i WHERE NOT i.deleted AND i.payment_status != 'paid' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoice_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

natural_query: give me revenue this year (2026)
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue 
FROM "invoices" i 
WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

natural_query: how many contacts are in each lifecycle stage?
sql:
SELECT 
  c."lifecycleStage", 
  COUNT(*) AS contact_count
FROM 
  "contacts" c 
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND c."lifecycleStage" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
  c."lifecycleStage" 
ORDER BY 
  contact_count DESC

natural_query: who achieved their target last month?
sql:
SELECT u.name 
FROM "users" u 
JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id 
LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) = t.month 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = t.year 
  AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted 
WHERE t.month = 4 AND t.year = 2026 
GROUP BY u.name, t."targetInUSD" 
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) >= t."targetInUSD"

natural_query: who did not achieve their target last month?
sql:
SELECT u.name
FROM "users" u
JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id
LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) = 4
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM s.sales_date) = 2026
  AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
WHERE t.month = 4 AND t.year = 2026
GROUP BY u.name, t."targetInUSD"
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) < t."targetInUSD"

natural_query: which reps achieved target in April 2026?
sql:

natural_query: which reps did NOT achieve target in April 2026?
sql:

natural_query: how many overdue tasks are there?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS overdue_task_count 
FROM "createtasks" 
WHERE NOT deleted 
  AND due_date < NOW() 
  AND status != 'Completed'

natural_query: list all bills with their individual net payable amounts
sql:
SELECT b._id, b."systemBillNo", b."billDate", b."dueDate", b.status, b."netPayableAmount", 
       b."gstPercent", b.subtotal, b."billType", v."companyName" AS vendor_name
FROM "bills" b 
LEFT JOIN "vendors" v ON v._id = b.vendor

natural_query: how many activity logs per user?
sql:
SELECT u.name, COALESCE(COUNT(al._id), 0) AS activity_log_count 
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "activitylogs" al ON al."userId" = u._id 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY activity_log_count DESC

natural_query: Give me a complete sales pipeline leaderboard — each rep ranked by win rate, total won value, open pipeline value, and number of lost deals.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won_deals,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_won_value,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL THEN d.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS open_pipeline_value,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lost_deals,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) / 
    NULLIF(
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) + 
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) + 
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 
      0
    ), 
    1
  ) AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "users" u
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name
ORDER BY 
  win_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST,
  total_won_value DESC NULLS LAST

natural_query: Which deals are at risk? Show deals open more than 60 days, no activity in 14 days, with owner and company details.
sql:
SELECT 
  d.name AS deal_name, 
  d.stage AS deal_stage, 
  d."createdAt" AS deal_created_at, 
  u.name AS owner_name, 
  c."companyName" AS company_name
FROM 
  "deals" d
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner AND u."isActive" = true
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company AND NOT c.deleted
WHERE 
  d."dealWonAt" IS NULL 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."createdAt" < NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days'
  AND d._id NOT IN (
    SELECT al."recordId" 
    FROM "activitylogs" al 
    WHERE al.module = 'deals' 
    AND al."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
  )
ORDER BY 
  d."createdAt" ASC

natural_query: Compare this year vs last year: total deals created, won, lost, and average deal size by quarter.
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."createdAt") AS year,
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."createdAt") AS quarter,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS open_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS lost_deals,
  COUNT(*) AS total_deals,
  ROUND(AVG(d.grand_total_in_usd),2) AS avg_deal_size
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d."createdAt"),
  EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM d."createdAt")
ORDER BY 
  year, 
  quarter

natural_query: Give me a 360 analysis of the top 5 deal stages — count, total value, average age, and win/loss rate from each stage.
sql:
SELECT 
  dss."dealStageName" AS stage_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_value_usd,
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - d."createdAt")) / 3600), 0) AS average_age_hours,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id), 0), 
    2
  ) AS win_rate_pct,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id), 0), 
    2
  ) AS loss_rate_pct
FROM 
  "deals" d
  LEFT JOIN "dealstagesettings" dss ON d.stage = dss."dealStageName"
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
  AND dss."dealStageName" IN (
    'Analysis - To be Quoted',
    'Closed Lost',
    'Closed Won',
    'Contract Under Review',
    'Negotiation',
    'On Hold',
    'Quotation Sent'
  )
GROUP BY 
  dss._id, 
  dss."dealStageName"
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC 
LIMIT 5

natural_query: Which companies have the highest deal conversion rate (won/total deals) with at least 3 deals?
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(d._id) AS total_deals,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)/COUNT(d._id),2) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM 
  "companies" c
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.company = c._id AND NOT d.deleted
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c._id, c."companyName"
HAVING 
  COUNT(d._id) >= 3
ORDER BY 
  conversion_rate_pct DESC

natural_query: Give me a full accounts receivable aging report — invoices grouped by 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days overdue with company and amount.
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.due_date < NOW() AND i.payment_status NOT IN ('paid','cancelled') AND NOT i.deleted AND i.due_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "0-30 days",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.due_date < NOW() AND i.payment_status NOT IN ('paid','cancelled') AND NOT i.deleted AND i.due_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' AND i.due_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "31-60 days",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.due_date < NOW() AND i.payment_status NOT IN ('paid','cancelled') AND NOT i.deleted AND i.due_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' AND i.due_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "61-90 days",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.due_date < NOW() AND i.payment_status NOT IN ('paid','cancelled') AND NOT i.deleted AND i.due_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN i.grand_total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "90+ days"
FROM 
  "invoices" i
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company AND NOT c.deleted
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c._id, c."companyName"
ORDER BY 
  c."companyName"

natural_query: Revenue leaderboard: rank all sales reps by total revenue collected (paid invoices) this year with monthly breakdown.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) AS payment_year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.payment_date) AS payment_month,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "users" u
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id AND NOT s.deleted
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.so_number = s._id AND i.payment_status = 'paid' AND NOT i.deleted
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date),
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.payment_date)
ORDER BY 
  rep_name, 
  payment_year, 
  payment_month

natural_query: Identify top 10 clients by total revenue paid, with their invoice count, average invoice value, and payment cycle.
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COUNT(i._id) AS invoice_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue,
  COALESCE(AVG(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS avg_invoice_value,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date)), 0) AS payment_cycle_years
FROM 
  "companies" c 
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id AND i.payment_status = 'paid' AND NOT i.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName"
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC 
LIMIT 10

natural_query: Give me a contact quality analysis — contacts per company, percentage with email, percentage with phone, percentage with activity in last 30 days.
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT ct._id) AS total_contacts,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ct.email IS NOT NULL THEN ct._id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ct._id), 0), 2) AS percent_with_email,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ct."phoneNumber" IS NOT NULL THEN ct._id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ct._id), 0), 2) AS percent_with_phone,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN al."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN ct._id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ct._id), 0), 2) AS percent_with_recent_activity
FROM 
  "companies" c
  LEFT JOIN "contacts" ct ON ct.company = c._id AND NOT ct.deleted
  LEFT JOIN "activitylogs" al ON al."recordId" = ct._id AND al.module = 'contacts'
GROUP BY 
  c._id, c."companyName"
ORDER BY 
  total_contacts DESC

natural_query: Build a contact growth report — new contacts added per month for the last 12 months with cumulative total.
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c."createdAt") AS month,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c."createdAt") AS year,
  COUNT(c._id) AS new_contacts,
  SUM(COUNT(c._id)) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c."createdAt"), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c."createdAt")) AS cumulative_total
FROM 
  "contacts" c
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND c."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead'
  AND c."createdAt" >= '2025-05-22'
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c."createdAt"),
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c."createdAt")
ORDER BY 
  year, 
  month

natural_query: Give me a company health dashboard — for each company show: owner, lifecycle stage, total deals (open/won/lost), total revenue, last activity date, and open task count.
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName" AS company_name,
  u.name AS owner_name,
  c."lifecycleStage" AS lifecycle_stage,
  COALESCE(d.deal_count, 0) AS total_deals,
  COALESCE(d.revenue_usd, 0) AS total_revenue_usd,
  c."createdAt" AS company_created_at,
  COALESCE(ct.task_count, 0) AS open_task_count
FROM 
  "companies" c
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = c."companyOwner"
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      d.company,
      COUNT(d._id) AS deal_count,
      COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS revenue_usd
    FROM 
      "deals" d
    WHERE 
      NOT d.deleted
    GROUP BY 
      d.company
  ) d ON d.company = c._id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      ct."companyId",
      COUNT(ct._id) AS task_count
    FROM 
      "createtasks" ct
    WHERE 
      NOT ct.deleted
      AND ct.status != 'Completed'
    GROUP BY 
      ct."companyId"
  ) ct ON ct."companyId" = c._id
ORDER BY 
  c."createdAt" DESC

natural_query: Which companies are at churn risk? Show companies with: no paid invoice in 6 months, no activity in 30 days, and lifecycle stage = Customer.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c."companyName"
FROM "companies" c
LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id AND NOT i.deleted AND i.payment_status = 'paid'
LEFT JOIN "activitylogs" al ON al."recordId" = c._id AND al.module = 'companies'
WHERE c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer'
  AND (i.payment_date IS NULL OR i.payment_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months')
  AND (al."createdAt" IS NULL OR al."createdAt" < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')

natural_query: Company acquisition analysis: how many companies were acquired per month per rep with conversion rate from lead to customer.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c."createdAt") AS month,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c."createdAt") AS year,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer' THEN 1 END) AS customers_acquired,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN c."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead' THEN 1 END) AS leads,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer' THEN 1 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN c."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead' OR c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer' THEN 1 END), 0), 
    2
  ) AS conversion_rate
FROM 
  "companies" c
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = c."companyOwner"
WHERE 
  NOT c.deleted 
  AND c."createdAt" >= '2025-05-22'
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c."createdAt"),
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c."createdAt")
ORDER BY 
  year, 
  month, 
  rep_name

natural_query: Compare companies by region — number of companies, total revenue, average deal size, win rate.
sql:
SELECT 
  r."regionName", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT c._id) AS company_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue, 
  COALESCE(AVG(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS avg_deal_size,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(d._id), 0), 2) AS win_rate
FROM 
  "regions" r
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c.region = r._id AND NOT c.deleted
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.company = c._id AND NOT d.deleted
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id AND i.payment_status = 'paid' AND NOT i.deleted
GROUP BY 
  r._id, r."regionName"
ORDER BY 
  company_count DESC

natural_query: Identify cross-sell/upsell opportunities: companies that are customers but have no deal in the last 6 months.
sql:
SELECT c."companyName", c._id 
FROM "companies" c 
WHERE c."lifecycleStage" = 'Customer' 
  AND NOT c.deleted 
  AND c._id NOT IN (
    SELECT d.company 
    FROM "deals" d 
    WHERE d.type IN ('Cross-sell', 'Upsell') 
      AND NOT d.deleted 
      AND d."createdAt" >= '2025-11-23'
  )

natural_query: Sales performance leaderboard — rank all reps by confirmed sales value, order count, average order value, and growth vs last quarter.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_sales,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' THEN s._id END) AS order_count,
  COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' THEN s.grand_total_in_usd END), 0) AS avg_order_value,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) IN (1,2,3) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026 THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_q_sales,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) IN (4,5) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026 THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_q_sales,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) IN (4,5) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026 THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) -
     COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) IN (1,2,3) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026 THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0)) /
    NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Confirm' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) IN (1,2,3) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026 THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0), 0)
  , 2) AS growth_pct
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id AND NOT s.deleted
WHERE 
  u."isActive" = true
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name
ORDER BY 
  total_sales DESC NULLS LAST, 
  order_count DESC NULLS LAST, 
  avg_order_value DESC NULLS LAST, 
  growth_pct DESC NULLS LAST

natural_query: Compare sales vs invoice revenue by month — are all confirmed sales being invoiced?
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) AS sales_month,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) AS sales_year,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS sales_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS invoice_revenue
FROM 
  "sales" s
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.so_number = s._id AND i.payment_status = 'paid' AND NOT i.deleted
WHERE 
  s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = 2026
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date),
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date)
ORDER BY 
  sales_month

natural_query: Monthly sales trend analysis for last 12 months: total value, order count, average value, and top rep of each month.
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) AS month,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) AS year,
  COUNT(s._id) AS order_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_value,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(s._id), 0), 2) AS average_value,
  u.name AS top_rep
FROM 
  "sales" s
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = s."salesOwner"
WHERE 
  s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
  AND s.sales_date >= '2025-05-22'
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date),
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date),
  u.name
ORDER BY 
  year, 
  month

natural_query: Which products (from sales items JSONB) are ordered most frequently and what is their combined revenue?
sql:
SELECT 
  jsonb_array_elements(s.items)->>'name' AS product_name, 
  COUNT(*) AS order_count, 
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "sales" s
WHERE 
  s.status = 'Confirm' 
  AND NOT s.deleted
GROUP BY 
  jsonb_array_elements(s.items)->>'name'
ORDER BY 
  order_count DESC, 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: Outreach funnel analysis: by campaign — prospects added, contacted, interested, converted, with conversion rate and average conversion time.
sql:
SELECT 
  c."campaignName", 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'Contacted' THEN o._id END) AS contacted_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o."leadStatus" = 'Intrested' THEN o._id END) AS interested_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'Converted to Deal' THEN o._id END) AS converted_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o._id) AS total_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'Converted to Deal' THEN o._id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o._id), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate,
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (SELECT MIN(o2."createdAt") FROM "outreaches" o2 WHERE o2._id = o._id AND o2.status = 'Converted to Deal') - o."createdAt")) AS avg_conversion_time
FROM 
  "campaigns" c
  LEFT JOIN "outreaches" o ON o.campaign = c._id AND NOT o."isDeleted"
GROUP BY 
  c._id, c."campaignName"
ORDER BY 
  total_count DESC

natural_query: Rep performance on outreach: assigned count, contacted, converted, conversion rate ranked by best performer.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT o._id), 0) AS outreach_assigned_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Contacted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outreach_contacted_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Converted to Deal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outreach_converted_count,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Converted to Deal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) / 
    NULLIF(COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT o._id), 0), 0), 
    2
  ) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM 
  "users" u 
  LEFT JOIN "outreaches" o ON o."assignedTo" = u._id AND NOT o."isDeleted"
GROUP BY 
  u._id, 
  u.name 
ORDER BY 
  conversion_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST, 
  outreach_converted_count DESC NULLS LAST

natural_query: Monthly outreach health report: new prospects, conversion rate, stale prospects (no update in 30 days), by rep and region.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  r."regionName" AS region_name, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT o._id) FILTER (WHERE o."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') AS new_prospects,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o._id) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'Converted to Deal' AND o."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') AS converted_prospects,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o._id) FILTER (WHERE o."createdAt" < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month' AND o."leadStatus" != 'Converted to Deal' AND o."leadStatus" != 'Lost') AS stale_prospects,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o._id) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'Converted to Deal' AND o."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o._id) FILTER (WHERE o."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month'), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate
FROM 
  "outreaches" o
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON o."assignedTo" = u._id
  LEFT JOIN "regions" r ON o.region = r._id
WHERE 
  NOT o."isDeleted"
GROUP BY 
  u.name, 
  r."regionName"
ORDER BY 
  rep_name, 
  region_name

natural_query: Product catalog analysis: by product type — active count, average price, billable vs non-billable, monthly vs annual billing breakdown.
sql:
SELECT 
  pt.name AS product_type,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN p."isActive" THEN 1 END) AS active_product_count,
  ROUND(AVG(p.unit_cost), 2) AS average_price_usd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p."isNoNBillable" = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS billable_product_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p."isNoNBillable" = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_billable_product_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.billing_frequency = 'Monthly' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_billing_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.billing_frequency = 'Annual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS annual_billing_count
FROM 
  "products" p
  LEFT JOIN "projecttypes" pt ON pt._id = p.product_type
GROUP BY 
  pt.name
ORDER BY 
  active_product_count DESC

natural_query: Which products are most referenced in sales orders? (from sales.items JSONB) Show product name, order frequency, total revenue.
sql:
SELECT 
  jsonb_array_elements(s.items)->>'name' AS product_name, 
  COUNT(*) AS order_frequency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  "sales" s
WHERE 
  s.status = 'Confirm' 
  AND NOT s.deleted
GROUP BY 
  jsonb_array_elements(s.items)->>'name'
ORDER BY 
  order_frequency DESC, 
  total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST

natural_query: Price tier analysis: group products into low (<$100), medium ($100-$1000), high (>$1000) tiers by product type and billing frequency.
sql:
SELECT 
  p.product_type, 
  p.billing_frequency, 
  CASE 
    WHEN p.unit_cost < 100 THEN 'Low'
    WHEN p.unit_cost BETWEEN 100 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium'
    WHEN p.unit_cost > 1000 THEN 'High'
  END AS price_tier,
  COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM 
  "products" p
WHERE 
  p."isActive" = true
GROUP BY 
  p.product_type, 
  p.billing_frequency, 
  CASE 
    WHEN p.unit_cost < 100 THEN 'Low'
    WHEN p.unit_cost BETWEEN 100 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium'
    WHEN p.unit_cost > 1000 THEN 'High'
  END
ORDER BY 
  p.product_type, 
  p.billing_frequency, 
  price_tier

natural_query: Notes activity report: notes added per user per month for last 3 months, broken down by associated module (deal, company, contact, invoice).
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS user_name, 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM n."createdAt") AS month, 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM n."createdAt") AS year, 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cn."dealId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deal_notes,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cn."companyId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS company_notes,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cn."contactId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS contact_notes,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cn."invoiceId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS invoice_notes
FROM 
  "notes" n
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = n."createdBy"
  LEFT JOIN "commonnotes" cn ON cn._id = n."outreachId"
WHERE 
  n."createdAt" >= '2026-02-21'
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name, 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM n."createdAt"), 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM n."createdAt")
ORDER BY 
  user_name, 
  year, 
  month

natural_query: Task overdue analysis: show all overdue tasks with owner, company/deal linked, days overdue, priority — sorted by most critical.
sql:
SELECT 
  ct."Task" AS task_name,
  u.name AS task_owner,
  COALESCE(c."companyName", d.name) AS company_deal_name,
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NOW() - ct.due_date)) AS days_overdue,
  ct.priority AS task_priority
FROM 
  "createtasks" ct
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = ct."createdBy"
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = ct."companyId"
  LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d._id = ct."dealsId"
WHERE 
  ct.due_date < NOW()
  AND ct.status != 'Completed'
  AND NOT ct.deleted
ORDER BY 
  ct.priority DESC,
  days_overdue DESC

natural_query: Task completion rate by user this month: assigned vs completed with average completion time.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS user_name,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ct.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 END) AS completed_tasks,
  COUNT(ct._id) AS total_tasks,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN ct.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 END) / 
           NULLIF(COUNT(ct._id), 0), 
    2
  ) AS completion_rate,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM AVG(ct.due_date - ct."createdAt")) AS avg_completion_time
FROM 
  "users" u
  LEFT JOIN "createtasks" ct ON ct."createdBy" = u._id AND NOT ct.deleted
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ct."createdAt") = 2026
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ct."createdAt") = 5
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name
HAVING 
  COUNT(ct._id) > 0
ORDER BY 
  completion_rate DESC

natural_query: Target achievement leaderboard: for each sales rep show — target, achieved, gap, achievement percentage, and months hit vs missed in 2026.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  t."targetInUSD",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS achieved,
  t."targetInUSD" - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gap,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted THEN s.grand_total_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) / NULLIF(t."targetInUSD", 0), 2) AS achievement_pct,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date)::TEXT, ', ') AS hit_months,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date)::TEXT, ', ') FILTER (WHERE s.grand_total_in_usd < t."targetInUSD" OR s.grand_total_in_usd IS NULL) AS missed_months
FROM 
  "users" u
  JOIN "targets" t ON t."userId" = u._id AND t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  LEFT JOIN "sales" s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = t.year AND NOT s.deleted
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name, t."targetInUSD", t.month
ORDER BY 
  achievement_pct DESC NULLS LAST

natural_query: Audit trail: show all actions on a specific company or deal — what changed, who changed it, and when.
sql:
SELECT 
  al.action, 
  al."recordName", 
  u.name AS user_name, 
  al."ipAddress", 
  al."userAgent", 
  al."createdAt"
FROM 
  "activitylogs" al
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = al."userId"
WHERE 
  al."recordId" = 'company_id'  -- replace 'company_id' with actual company or deal ID
  AND al.module IN ('companies', 'deals')
ORDER BY 
  al."createdAt" DESC

natural_query: Notification engagement report: sent vs read rate by user and notification type.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS user_name,
  n.type AS notification_type,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN n.receivers @> jsonb_build_array(u._id) THEN 1 END) AS sent_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN n.receivers @> jsonb_build_array(u._id) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM emails e WHERE e."messageId" = n._id AND e.user = u._id
  ) THEN 1 END) AS read_count
FROM 
  "notifications" n
  CROSS JOIN "users" u
WHERE 
  NOT n."isDeleted"
GROUP BY 
  u._id, u.name, n.type
ORDER BY 
  user_name, notification_type

natural_query: Vendor spend analysis: for each vendor show total bills count, total amount, paid vs pending bills, and average bill value.
sql:
SELECT 
  v."companyName" AS vendor_name,
  COUNT(b._id) AS total_bills,
  COALESCE(SUM(b."netPayableAmount"), 0) AS total_amount,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'Paid' THEN b."netPayableAmount" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_amount,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.status NOT IN ('Paid') THEN b."netPayableAmount" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_amount,
  COALESCE(AVG(b."netPayableAmount"), 0) AS average_bill_value
FROM 
  "vendors" v
  LEFT JOIN "bills" b ON b.vendor = v._id
GROUP BY 
  v._id, v."companyName"
ORDER BY 
  total_amount DESC

natural_query: Bills payable summary: vendor name, bill number, amount, tax, TDS, net payable, status — sorted by due date ascending.
sql:
SELECT 
  v."companyName" AS vendor_name,
  b."systemBillNo" AS bill_number,
  b.subtotal AS amount,
  b."gstPercent" AS tax,
  b."gstPercent" * b.subtotal / 100 AS tax_amount,
  b."netPayableAmount" AS net_payable,
  b.status AS bill_status
FROM 
  "bills" b
  LEFT JOIN "vendors" v ON v._id = b.vendor
ORDER BY 
  b."dueDate" ASC

natural_query: Deal stage funnel: for each stage show deal count, total value, average age of deals, and win rate from that stage.
sql:
SELECT 
  dss."dealStageName" AS stage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deal_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_value_usd,
  COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (CURRENT_DATE - d."createdAt"))), 0) AS avg_deal_age_days,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d._id), 0), 
    2
  ) AS win_rate_pct
FROM 
  "deals" d
  LEFT JOIN "dealstagesettings" dss ON d.stage = dss."dealStageName"
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  dss._id, 
  dss."dealStageName"
ORDER BY 
  dss."dealStageName"

natural_query: Monthly cash flow: paid invoice revenue vs confirmed sales orders vs targets for each month of this year.
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.payment_date) AS month,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS paid_invoice_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS confirmed_sales_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(t."targetInUSD"), 0) AS target_revenue
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
  FULL OUTER JOIN "sales" s ON EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date)
  LEFT JOIN "targets" t ON EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.payment_date) = t.month 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = t.year
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND s.status = 'Confirm'
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.payment_date)
ORDER BY 
  month

natural_query: Deal win/loss analysis: what are the most common stages where deals are lost? By rep and by company industry.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name, 
  c.industry, 
  d.stage AS lost_stage, 
  COUNT(*) AS deal_count
FROM 
  "deals" d
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
  AND d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL 
  AND d.stage NOT IN ('Closed Won', 'Analysis - To be Quoted')
GROUP BY 
  u.name, 
  c.industry, 
  d.stage
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: Which customers have reduced their spend this year vs last year?
sql:
SELECT 
  c."companyName", 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN i.grandtotal_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_year_spend,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN i.grandtotal_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_year_spend
FROM 
  "companies" c
  LEFT JOIN "invoices" i ON i.company = c._id AND NOT i.deleted
GROUP BY 
  c._id, 
  c."companyName"
HAVING 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN i.grandtotal_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0) < 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 THEN i.grandtotal_in_usd ELSE 0 END), 0)
ORDER BY 
  current_year_spend ASC

natural_query: New vs returning customers: how many companies invoiced this year were also invoiced last year?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i1.company) AS num_companies
FROM "invoices" i1
JOIN "invoices" i2 ON i1."companyName" = i2."companyName"
WHERE 
  -- This year invoices filter
  (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i1.payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE))
  AND
  -- Last year invoices filter
  (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i2.payment_date) = (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1))

natural_query: Task overload report: which reps have 5+ overdue high-priority tasks along with their open deal count?
sql:
SELECT 
    u.name AS rep_name,
    COUNT(d._id) AS open_deals_count
FROM 
    "users" u
JOIN 
    "createtasks" ct ON u._id = ct."createdBy"
LEFT JOIN 
    "deals" d ON u._id = d.owner AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL
WHERE 
    ct.status != 'Completed' 
    AND ct.priority = 'High'
    AND ct.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY 
    u.name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ct._id) >= 5

natural_query: Response time analysis: average time from lead created to first outreach note added, by rep.
sql:
SELECT u.name AS rep_name, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (n."createdAt" - o."createdAt"))) AS avg_response_time 
FROM "outreaches" o 
JOIN "notes" n ON o._id = n."outreachId" 
JOIN "users" u ON n."createdBy" = u._id 
WHERE NOT o."isDeleted" 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name 
ORDER BY avg_response_time ASC NULLS LAST

natural_query: Deal aging report: deals open by age bucket (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days) with owner and stage.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS owner_name, 
  d.stage, 
  CASE 
    WHEN d."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN '0-30 days'
    WHEN d."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' THEN '31-60 days'
    WHEN d."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN '61-90 days'
    ELSE '90+ days'
  END AS age_bucket
FROM "deals" d
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner
WHERE d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL AND NOT d.deleted
ORDER BY u.name, d.stage, age_bucket

natural_query: Outreach rep performance: how many prospects assigned, contacted, converted, with revenue from converted per rep.
sql:
SELECT 
  u.name AS rep_name,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN o."leadStatus" = '-' THEN 1 END) AS prospects_assigned,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Contacted' THEN 1 END) AS prospects_contacted,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Converted to Deal' THEN 1 END) AS deals_converted,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS revenue_from_converted
FROM 
  "outreaches" o
INNER JOIN 
  "users" u ON o."assignedTo" = u._id
LEFT JOIN 
  "invoices" i ON i.company = (SELECT c._id FROM "companies" c WHERE c._id = o."leadStatus") AND i.payment_status = 'paid'
WHERE 
  NOT o."isDeleted"
GROUP BY 
  u.name
ORDER BY 
  rep_name

natural_query: Geographic analysis: companies, revenue, and deal win rate by country and region.
sql:
SELECT 
  c.country,
  r."regionName",
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'paid' THEN i.grandtotal_in_usd ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id ELSE NULL END) AS won_deals,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL THEN d._id ELSE NULL END) AS lost_deals
FROM 
  "companies" c
LEFT JOIN 
  "invoices" i ON c._id = i.company AND NOT i.deleted
LEFT JOIN 
  "deals" d ON c._id = d.company AND NOT d.deleted
LEFT JOIN 
  "regions" r ON c.region = r._id
GROUP BY 
  c.country, r."regionName"
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC

natural_query: List all departments
sql:
SELECT "name" AS department_name
FROM departments

natural_query: How many unread notifications are there?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unread_notification_count
FROM notifications
WHERE "isDeleted" = false AND type = 'Task Assigned' OR type = 'Verified'

natural_query: How many prospects were added and converted each month this year?
sql:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o."createdAt") AS year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o."createdAt") AS month,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Contacted' THEN 1 END) AS prospects_contacted,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Converted to Deal' THEN 1 END) AS prospects_converted
FROM 
    outreaches o
WHERE 
    o."createdAt" >= '2026-01-01' AND o."createdAt" <= '2026-12-31'
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o."createdAt"),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o."createdAt")
ORDER BY 
    year,
    month

natural_query: Target trend analysis: for each rep show monthly target vs actual for last 6 months with cumulative achievement rate.
sql:
SELECT 
    u.name AS rep_name,
    t.month,
    t.year,
    t."targetInUSD" AS monthly_target,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS cumulative_actual,
    (COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) / t."targetInUSD") * 100 AS cumulative_achievement_rate
FROM 
    users u
LEFT JOIN 
    sales s ON s."salesOwner" = u._id AND s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted
LEFT JOIN 
    targets t ON t."userId" = u._id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sales_date) = t.year AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.sales_date) = t.month
WHERE 
    t.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1
GROUP BY 
    u.name, t.month, t.year, t."targetInUSD"
ORDER BY 
    u.name, t.year, t.month

natural_query: Pipeline velocity: for each stage, average number of days deals spend before moving or closing.
sql:
SELECT 
    d.stage, 
    AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM d."dealWonAt" - d."createdAt")) AS avg_days_before_won,
    AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM d."dealLostAt" - d."createdAt")) AS avg_days_before_lost
FROM 
    deals d
WHERE 
    d."dealWonAt" IS NOT NULL AND NOT d.deleted
    OR d."dealLostAt" IS NOT NULL AND NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
    d.stage

natural_query: Forecast this quarter: total open deal value weighted by stage (e.g., Proposal=30%, Negotiation=70%, Contract=90%).
sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(d.grand_total_in_usd * CASE 
        WHEN d.stage = 'Proposal' THEN 0.30
        WHEN d.stage = 'Negotiation' THEN 0.70
        WHEN d.stage = 'Contract' THEN 0.90
        ELSE 0
    END) AS weighted_open_deal_value
FROM 
    deals d
WHERE 
    d.stage IN ('Proposal', 'Negotiation', 'Contract') 
    AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL 
    AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL 
    AND NOT d.deleted

natural_query: End-of-month pipeline review: all open deals this month — value, stage, owner, last activity, and probability score by stage.
sql:
SELECT 
    d.name AS deal_name,
    d.stage AS deal_stage,
    d.owner AS deal_owner,
    d."lastActivity" AS deal_last_activity,
    d.grand_total_in_usd AS deal_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN d.stage = 'Analysis - To be Quoted' THEN 10
        WHEN d.stage = 'Closed Lost' THEN 5
        WHEN d.stage = 'Closed Won' THEN 80
        WHEN d.stage = 'Contract Under Review' THEN 60
        WHEN d.stage = 'Negotiation' THEN 40
        WHEN d.stage = 'On Hold' THEN 30
        WHEN d.stage = 'Quotation Sent' THEN 20
    END AS probability_score
FROM 
    deals d
WHERE 
    d.stage IN ('Analysis - To be Quoted', 'Closed Lost', 'Closed Won', 'Contract Under Review', 'Negotiation', 'On Hold', 'Quotation Sent')
    AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL
    AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL
    AND d.deleted = FALSE
    AND d."createdAt" >= '2026-05-01' AND d."createdAt" < '2026-06-01'
ORDER BY 
    d.stage, d.grand_total_in_usd DESC

natural_query: show me activity logs from February 2028
sql:
SELECT * FROM activitylogs al
WHERE al."createdAt" >= '2028-02-01' AND al."createdAt" < '2028-03-01'

natural_query: Churn risk dashboard: customers with no activity in 60+ days, no open deals, and no recent invoice.
sql:
SELECT c._id, c."companyName", c."createdAt", c."leadStatus", c."lifecycleStage", c."clientHealth", c."userType"
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN deals d ON d.company = c._id AND d."dealWonAt" IS NULL AND d."dealLostAt" IS NULL AND NOT d.deleted

natural_query: who is not achive task last 6 months (referring to deals)
sql:
SELECT u.name 
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id AND NOT d.deleted

AND d."createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months' 
GROUP BY u.name

ORDER BY u.name

natural_query: give me last 6 month task by users (referring to deals)

natural_query: Which sales rep has the highest conversion rate from lead to deal?
sql:
SELECT u.name AS rep_name, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) AS deals_count, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT o._id) AS leads_count, 
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT d._id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o._id), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate
FROM "users" u
LEFT JOIN "outreaches" o ON o."assignedTo" = u._id AND NOT o."isDeleted"
LEFT JOIN "deals" d ON d.owner = u._id AND NOT d.deleted AND d."createdAt" > o."createdAt"
WHERE u."isActive" = true
GROUP BY u._id, u.name
ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

  SELECT u.name AS rep_name, COUNT(c._id) AS account_count,

  FROM "users" u
